tei:div.tei:p: (tha)༄༅// chos spyod nyer mkho yan lag nyi shu pa yid bzhin nor bu'i them skas zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti/ chos spyod yan lag nyi shu pa shin tu bsdus te bya ba'i tshul la/ sdom ni/ sa ga

1 zhi gnas khang 2 mchod pa ba 3 rlab// tshogs zhing spyan dra 4 nga byon leg 5 sa bya// khrus gsol 6 sku phyi rgya 7 na 8 byugs 9 'bul// phyag 'tshal 10 bstod 11 mchod 12 sdig pa bsha 13 gas// skya 14 bas sem 15 sa yi ra 16 ngas chos 'khor ba 17 skul// bzhugs gsol 18 bsngo ba 19 bkra shis 20 te// chos spyod yan lag nyi shu'o// zhes pa ltar shin tu bsdus pa'i tshul gyis byed na/ skyabs gnas dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// tshogs gnyis mnga' thang chos dbyings dag stobs kyis// snod bcud bde can zhing gi bkod pa'i dbus// yid 'phrog nor bu'i gzhal med khang chen por// rin chen seng khri pad zla'i gdan mchog dang*// dngos bshams gzungs rig mos stobs kyis sprul pa'i// mchod sprin rgya mtshos gang zhing spyod gyur cig /spro na mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod/ de nas 'dun pa rtse gcig pas/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// ces pas tshogs zhing spyan drang*/ bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams bskal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// ces 'byon legs bya/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// ces khrus gsol/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// zhes sku phyi/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog rgya phrag dag kyang dbul bar bgyi// zhes rgyan dang*/

stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byugs par bgyi// zhes byugs pa 'bul/ bdag dang 'gro la thugs brtse'i phyir// nyid kyi rdzu 'phrul mthu yis ni// ji srid mchod pa bdag bgyid na// de srid bcom ldan bzhugs su gsol// zhes brjod pas tshogs kyi zhing du brtan par bzhugs par bsam/ ji snyed su dag sogs nas bstod par bgyi zhes pa'i bar phyag 'tshal zhing bstod/ me tog dam pa sogs shlo ka gsum gyis mchod cing*/ spro na mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs dang rol mo bya/ maṇḍal 'bul/ 'dod chags zhe sdang sogs bshags pa bya/ de nas byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar sogs sam/ bsdu na/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs lan gsum gyis skyabs sems blang*/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sogs nas/ phyir bsngo'o zhes pa'i bar gyis rjes su yi rangs sogs yan lag bzhi dang*/ smon lam rgyas bsdus ji ltar rigs pa gdab/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// 'di la gdan khri byin rlabs dang*/ bzhugs su gsol ba'i yan lag dang*/ smon lam gyi yan lag so sor bgrangs pas yan lag nyi shu rtsa gsum du'ang 'gyur ro// zhes pa'ang mañdzu gho ṣas bris// ༈ /oṃ swa sti pra dzā bhyaḥ skyabs gnas kun 'dus bla ma dang*// dkon mchog gsum la gus btud nas// las dang po la nyer mkho'i phyir// spyod pa'i rim pa cung zad bshad// de la dang po'i las can rnams kyis nyin zhag phrugs gcig gi nyams len gyi rim pa yan lag nyi shur bsdus nas brjod pa la/ thog mar sbyor ba ni/ gtsug lag khang la sogs pa'i gnas khang dri bzang po'i chus chag chag gdab cing phyag dar byas/ rgyan gyi bye brag ji ltar 'byor pa yid du 'ong bar byas pas brgyan/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang sems sogs kyi snang brnyan bris 'bur ji 'byor bsham/

de'i mdun du mchod stegs bang rim can dar ras kyis bkab pa la/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod gtsang zhing dag pa ji ltar 'byor pa dang*/ maṇḍal gyi chas dri bzang gi chu dang bcas pa/ khrus bum/ sku phyi/ gos zung bcas bkod mdzes su bshams nas/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma rin po che// bdag gi spyi bor padma'i gdan bzhugs la// bka' drin chen po'i sgo nas rjes bzung ste// sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// dngos grub thams cad kyi 'byung gnas/ skyabs gnas thams cad 'dus pa'i ngo bo/ dpal ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal rgyal ba shākya thub pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag gi lus dang ngag yid la phyi nang gi bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang bsrung zhing byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ dal 'byor 'di ni rnyed par shin tu dka'// skyes bu'i don sgrub thob par gyur pa la// gal te 'di la phan pa ma bsgrubs na// phyis 'di yang dag 'byor par ga la 'gyur// srid gsum mi rtag ston ka'i sprin dang 'dra// 'gro ba'i skye 'chi gar la lta dang mtshungs// 'gro ba'i tshe 'gro nam mkha'i glog 'dra ste// ri gzar 'bab chu bzhin du myur mgyogs 'gro// dus kyis bsnyen nas rgyal po 'gro 'gyur na// longs spyod mdza' dang gnyen bshes rjes mi 'brang*// skyes bu dag ni gang nas gang 'gro bar// las ni grib ma bzhin du rjes su 'brang*// sred srid ma rig dbang gis skye bo rnams// mi dang lha dang ngan song rnam gsum po// 'gro ba lnga po dag ni mi mkhas 'khor// dper na rdza mkhan 'khor lo 'khor ba bzhin// srid gsum rga dang nad kyi sdug bsngal 'bar// 'di na 'chi me rab 'bar mgon med de// srid las byung la 'gro ba rtag tu rmongs// bum par chud pa'i bung ba 'khor ba bzhin// zhes brjod cing don bsam mo// bdag dang 'gro ba nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad dus 'di nas bzung ste ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// zhes mang du brjod cing mthar/

sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs kyi mchog rnams la// byang chub bar du bdag ni skyabs su mchi// bdag gis sbyin sogs bgyis pa 'di dag gis// 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis skyabs gnas mthar thug pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum la yan lag bdun pa 'bul bar bgyi'o snyam du sems bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dang dus rtag tu mi 'bral bar gyur cig nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms la gnas par gyur cig dngos gzhi la nyi shu las dang pos gzhi byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis deng 'dir bdag cag gi ston pa shākya'i dbang po la sogs pa'i bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa dang 'phags pa chos skyong ba thams cad gdan 'dzoms pa'i pho brang gi dkyil 'khor dang*/ mchod pa'i tshogs sbyar ba 'di rnams ji ltar sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' de dag gi sngon gyi smon lam khyad par can gyis bsgrubs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das 'od dpag med kyi zhing gi bkod pa'i yon tan lta bu dang ldan par gyur te/ sa gzhi rin po che sna tshogs kyi rang bzhin lag mthil ltar mnyam pa/ tha gru che ba/ yangs pa/ reg na 'jam zhing bde ba/ dri ma med cing 'od gsal ba/ tsandan sbrul gyi snying po'i dri bsung dang ldan pa'i lha'i me tog sna tshogs kyis gcal du bkram pa/

mtha' rin po che'i pha gus brtsigs pa/ gser dang*/ dngul dang*/ mu tig gi bye ma gram bur brdal ba/ utpal dang*/ ku mud dang*/ padma 'gying zhing ldem pas khebs par gyur cing*/ chu bya sna tshogs snyan par sgrogs pa/ dga' zhing 'phyo la lding bas brgyan pa'i yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa'i mtsho dang rdzing bu dang ldeng ka dag gis mdzes par byas pa/ rin po che'i dpag bsam gyi shing ljon pa la lha'i nor bu dang*/ mu tig gi rgyan phreng dang rin po che dpyangs pa/ me tog gi mgo lcog dang 'bras bu mdzes par chags pas g.yur za zhing ldem pa/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer kha 'khrol pa las dam pa'i chos kyi sgra 'byung ba dang ldan pa tshar du sbrengs pas legs par brgyan pa'i sa gzhi phun sum tshogs pa 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod cing bsam mo// gnyis pa pho brang byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis zhing khams de'i dbus su gzhal med khang rin po che sna bdun mchog tu 'bar ba bkod pa/ 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa rgyas par 'gengs pa'i 'od zer chen po rab tu 'byung ba/ gnas tha dad pa shin tu rnam par phye ba mtha' yas pa rnam par gnas pa rgya yongs su ma chad pa/ khams gsum las yang dag par 'das pa'i spyod yul 'jig rten las yang dag par 'das pa de'i bla ma'i dge ba'i rtsa ba las byung ba/ shin tu rnam par dag cing dbang sgyur ba'i rnam par rig pa'i mtshan nyid/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gnas/ byang chub sems dpa'i dge 'dun dang ldan pa/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po dang*/ mi dang mi ma yin pa mtha' yas pa rnam par rgyu ba/

chos kyi ro'i dga' ba dang bde ba chen pos brtan pa/ sems can thams cad kyi don thams cad yang dag par thob par byed pas nye bar gnas pa/ nyon mongs pa'i gnod pa'i dri ma thams cad dang bral ba/ bdud thams cad yongs su spangs pa/ thams cad kyi bkod pa las lhag pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i bkod pa'i gnas/ dran pa dang blo gros dang rtog pa chen pos nges par 'byung ba/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong gi bzhon pas 'gro ba/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang*/ mtshan ma med pa dang*/ smon pa med pa nas 'jug pa/ rin po che padma'i rgyal po yon tan mtha' yas pas brgyan pa'i bkod pa la brten pa'i gzhal med khang chen po 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod/ gsum pa gdan khri byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis gzhal yas khang gi dbus su padma'i gdan la rin po che'i sna tshogs las grub pa'i seng ge chen po brgyad kyis bteg pa'i steng du padma dang zla ba'i gdan mtha' skor du rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma nyi ma zla ba'i gdan/ gzhan yang padma dang zla ba'i gdan sna tshogs pa bdag cag gi ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la sogs pa bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas sras dang bcas pa gdan 'dzom pa'i bzhugs gnas 'phags pa so so'i smon lam gyi khyad par dang*/ mnga' thang dang 'tshams par grub pa mdzes pa sha stag 'byung bar gyur cig ces brjod/ bzhi pa mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis phyi nang kun tu yang cha rigs dang 'tshams par lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa zhal zas dang na bza' dang rgyan dang rol mo la sogs phul du phyin pa sna tshogs pa phung po gsum pa'i mdo dang bzang po spyod pa'i smon lam las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho thams cad kyis rgyas par gang zhing rgyan klubs pa dang ldan par gyur cig

'phags pa thams cad kyang gdan 'dzom nas de bzhin du byin gyis brlabs shing bzhes te longs spyod par gyur cig ces brjod/ de nas rol mo sna tshogs pa dang bcas pas/ oṃ na mo bha ga wa te/ badzra sā ra pra mardha ni/ ta thā ga tā ya/ arha te/ samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzre badzre/ ma hā badzre/ ma hā te dza badzre/ ma hā bi dyā badzre/ ma hā bo dhi tsitta badzre/ ma hā bo dhi maṇḍo pa saṃ kra ma ṇa badzre sarba karma ā ba ra ṇa bi sho dha na badzre swā hā/ zhes mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs tshar gsum bton la/ dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis byin gyis brlabs dang*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs pa'i mnga' thang chen po dang*/ chos kyi dbyings rnam par dag cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyi de bzhin du gyur cig ces bden stobs brjod/ bzhi pa mchod yul spyan drang ba ni/ tshogs pa rnams bzhengs te bdug spos dang*/ mchod yon gyis bkang ba'i dung phor dang*/ ting bshags sogs rol mo thogs shing*/ dbyangs snyan po dang bcas pas/ rnam dag chos kyi dbyings las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la mchog tu gzigs// rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las sgrub mdzad pa'i// dus gsum bla ma 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol// ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// bcom ldan bskal pa grangs med du ma ru// 'gro la brtse phyir thugs rjes rnam sbyangs shing*// smon lam rgya chen dgongs pa yongs rdzogs pa// khyed bzhed 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags na// de phyir chos dbyings pho brang lhun grub nas// rdzu 'phrul byin rlabs sna tshogs ston mdzad cing*// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral ba'i phyir// yongs dag 'khor dang bcas te gshegs su gsol// phyogs dus kun khyab skyabs gsum bka' bsdod bcas// nyon mongs 'gro la mkhyen brtse rab dgongs nas// dpag med zhing nas thogs med rdzu 'phrul gyis// 'dir gshegs mchod sprin rgya mtsho'i dbus bzhugs gsol// lnga pa byon legs ni/

bcom ldan 'dir ni byon pa legs// bdag cag bsod nams skal bar ldan// bdag gi mchod yon bzhes nas kyang*// thugs la dgongs shing gnang bar mdzod// drug pa khrus gsol ni/ khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim par// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher bar star// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla bre bres pa der// ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar// lha yi chu ni dag pa yis// de bzhin bdag gis sku khrus gsol// 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// thugs rje'i chu ni bla na med// byin brlabs ye shes chu yin te// ci 'dod dngos grub stsol bar mdzod// khyed kyi rang bzhin yongs dag pas// sred sogs 'ching ba mi mnga' yang*// bdag cag sgrib pa sbyang slad du// gtsang ma chab kyis sku khrus gsol// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la nyon mongs mi mnga' yang*// sems can lus ngag yid gsum sgrib pa sbyangs slad du// rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs la khrus chab 'di gsol bas// sems can lus ngag yid gsum dri ma dag gyur cig /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// bdun pa sku phyi ba ni/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pa'i sku phyi'o// brgyad pa byug pa ni/ stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// spos mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// dgu pa rgyan 'bul ba ni/ de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag 'bul// bcu pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/

gang gi bka' drin 'od kyis gsal byas bdag nyid kyi// de nyid rin chen 'od kyi tshogs kyis mun bcom nas// mig skyon med rnams rol par gnas pas steng du ni// lta gyur bla ma nyi ma de la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// dus gsum bde gshegs sras bcas thams cad kyi// sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin byin brlabs pa// bka' drin chen po'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// dang por byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed nas// bskal pa grangs med gsum du tshogs bsags shing*// bar du gcod pa'i bdud bzhi 'dul mdzad pa// bcom ldan seng ge de la= /gang zhig 'byung po kun la thugs brtse bas// sngon chad ma thos chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// skyob pa lha dang mi rnams 'dul mdzad pa// srid pa mthar phyin de la= /gang tshe rkang gnyis gtso bo khyod bltams tshe// sa chen 'di la gom pa bdun bor nas// nga ni 'jig rten 'di na mchog ces gsungs// de tshe mkhas pa khyod la= /rnam dag sku mnga' mchog tu gzugs bzang ba// ye shes rgya mtsho gser gyi lhun po 'dra// grags pa 'jig rten gsum na lham me ba// mgon po mchog brnyes khyed= /gang tshe thub chen zhing pa'i grong bzhud tshe// 'dzam bu'i grib mas sku lus ma btang zhing*// lha bu gzhon nu drug gis btud gyur pa// de tshe mchod 'os khyod la= /mtshan mchog ldan pa dri med zla ba'i zhal// gser mdog 'dra ba khyod= /rdul bral khyod 'dra srid pa gsum ma mchis// mnyam med mkhyen can khyod= /mi mchog 'dul ba kha lo sgyur mdzad cing*// kun sbyor 'ching ba gcod mdzad de bzhin gshegs// dbang po zhi zhing nyer zhi zhi la mkhas// mnyan yod bzhugs pa de la= /chos sku nam mkha' bzhin du dbyer med kyang*// gzugs sku 'ja' tshon bzhin du so sor gsal// thabs dang shes rab mchog la mnga' brnyes pa'i// rigs lnga bde bar gshegs la=

/sangs rgyas rnam gzigs gtsug tor thams cad skyob// 'khor ba 'jig dang gser thub 'od srungs dang*// shākya thub pa gau tam lha yi lha// sangs rgyas dpa' bo bdun la= /mthun pa'i smon lam dge tshogs rmad byung zhing*// spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mched gyur la// bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la= /sngon tshe byang chub chen por thugs bskyed nas// tshogs gnyis yongs rdzogs dgongs pa mthar phyin pa'i// de bzhin gshegs pa drug khri lnga stong la// lus ngag yid gsum gus pas= /mtshan legs rin chen gser bzang mya ngan med// chos bsgrags mngon mkhyen sman bla shākya thub// rgya chen smon lam yongs su rdzogs pa yi// bde bar gshegs pa brgyad la= /nyi ma lta bur ma rig mun pa sel// zla ba lta bur nyon mongs gdung ba sel// dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla// bai ḍūrya yi 'od la= /'jig rten 'dren pa'i gtso bo tshe dpag med// dus min 'chi ba ma lus 'joms pa'i dpal// mgon med sdug bsngal gyur pa rnams kyi skyabs// sangs rgyas tshe dpag med la= /byams chen me yis zhe sdang bud shing sreg /ye shes 'od kyis ma rig mun pa sel// chos kyi rgyal tshab 'gro ba'i mgon mdzad pa// dga' ldan bzhugs pa de la= /rdo rje 'chang dbang rgyal ba rtag pa dang*// he ru ka dpal rdo rje nyi ma dang*// padma gar dbang rta yi rgyal po sogs// 'khor lo'i dbang phyug rnams la= /rgyal ba rigs lnga de bzhin gshegs yum bzhi// sems dpa' che dang khro bo'i dbang po rnams// rang rang rigs kyi lha mor bcas la sogs// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la= /rdo rje phag mo bdag med sna tshogs yum// ye shes dbang mo rdo rje ro langs ma// rdor dbyings dbang phyug la sogs dkyil 'khor gyi// 'khor los sgyur ma rnams la= /'dus pa bde dgyes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba dang*// gdan bzhi mā yā thod pa gshin rje'i gshed// dus kyi 'khor lo la sogs sngags rgyud kyi// ye shes lha tshogs kun la=

/gsang sngags rig sngags gzungs sngags snying po dang*// phyag rgya'i rigs byung la sogs sngags kyi lha// zhi khro'i lha tshogs rgyud sde bzhi po las// gang gsungs rnams la gus pas phyag bgyi'o// dus gsum bde bar gshegs pa chos kyi sku// 'gro drug sems can rnams la spyan ras gzigs// nam mkha' lta bur khyab pa'i bcu gcig zhal// gzi brjid 'od dpag med la= /phyag stong 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal po stong*// spyan stong bskal pa bzang po'i sangs rgyas stong*// gang la gang 'dul de la der ston pa'i// btsun pa spyan ras gzigs la= /dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi thugs kyi sras// gzhon nu'i tshul 'dzin rgyal sras 'jam pa'i dbyangs// bdud kyi dkyil 'khor mtha' dag 'joms mdzad pa// mkhyen brtse'i rang bzhin de la= /lcang lo can gyi gnas mchog dam pa na// gsang sngags rig sngags kun gyi bdag po ste// log 'dren bgegs kyi tshogs rnams 'joms mdzad pa'i// phyag na rdo rje bsnams la= /mgon po spyan ras gzigs dbang thugs rje can// don yod zhags pa khro rgyal rta mchog dang*// ral gcig ma dang khro gnyer can ma ste// 'phags pa lha lnga'i tshogs la= /dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku// ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma// rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs la= /seng ge glang chen me sprul chom rkun dang*// lcags sgrog rgya mtsho sha za'i 'jigs pa rnams// zhi mdzad zla ba'i 'od ltar mdzes pa'i sku// bcom ldan sgrol ma yum la= /sku yi skyon spangs mtshan dang dpe byad ldan// gsung gi skyon spangs ka la piṅka'i dbyangs// thugs kyi skyon spangs shes bya mtha' dag mkhyen// bkra shis dpal 'bar ma la= /rnam rgyal 'jig rten dbang phyug gsang ba'i bdag /mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dbyug sngon can// stobs po che dang lha yi bu gnyis po// rnam rgyal lha tshogs rnams la=

/'jam dbyangs phyag na rdo rje spyan ras gzigs// sa yi snying po sgrib pa rnam par sel// nam mkha'i snying po byams pa kun tu bzang*// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad la= /so sor 'brang ma stong chen rab 'byams dang*// rma bya chen mo gsang sngags rjes 'dzin dang*// bsil ba'i tshal dang gtsug tor gdugs dkar sogs// phrin las lha tshogs rnams la= /gang gi mtshan tsam 'dzin cing dran pas kyang*// 'jigs pa kun las rab tu skyob mdzad cing*// dri med bde chen nye bar stsol mdzad pa'i// lha mo 'od zer can la= /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yi// cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa sha wa rī// lha mo gang gis bsgrubs pa'i nad gdon bgegs// kun tu zhi mdzad ma la= /rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i gsung rab rgya mtsho yi// rnam par 'phrul pa'i dpal las legs byung zhing*// sgrub pa po la blo gros mchog ster ma// lha mo dbyangs can ma la= /ye shes ha ya grī wa rta mchog dpal// 'bar ba'i sku la ral pa gyen du brdzes// ma rig tshangs pa kha bub gnon pa'i lha// padma rigs sngags rgyal la= /chos dbyings rang bzhin ind+ra nī la'i mdog /zhal gcig phyag gnyis zhabs zung brjid pa'i sku// ye shes ral gri rdo rje zhags pa bsnams// khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la= /ye shes rgyal ba'i rigs kyi sprul pa ni// lha min 'joms shing bdud kyi klad pa 'gems// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gshin rje'i gshed// 'od chen khro bo'i rgyal la= /mthu stobs thogs med rdo rje rnam par 'joms// phrin las lhun grub bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sogs// khro bo mngags gzhug pho nya'i dbang po rnams// rig pa'i tshogs dang bcas la= /gtsug tor 'khor los sgyur dang mthar byed bzhi// stobs chen mi g.yo 'dod pa'i rgyal po dang*// dbyug sngon hūm̐ mdzad gnod mdzes rgyal po ste// phyogs bcu'i khro rgyal rnams la= /lha klu gnod sbyin lha min tshangs pa sogs// 'jig rten dregs pa kun gyis zhabs la btud// gdul dka' 'dul phyir dkyil 'khor sprul mdzad pa'i// 'jig rten gsum rgyal gtso la=

/'gro ba rgyud lnga 'khor ba'i dkyil 'khor du// sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor gyis gzir 'gro gzigs nas// thugs rjes sdug bsngal 'khrul 'khor 'joms mdzad pa// thugs rje'i bdag nyid khyed la= /sems can smin cing grol bar mdzad pa'i phyir// sems can khams na bzhugs shing spyod gyur kyang*// chags pas ma gos padma ltar dag pa// 'dod chags dag pa'i bdag nyid khyed la 'dud// sems can bkren pa chos kyi phongs gyur pa// ma rig thibs po'i nang du song ba rnams// 'phags pa'i nor bdun dag gis tshim mdzad pa// ye shes sgron me khyod la= /sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor nub pa rnams// thugs rjes thabs dang shes rab grur bcug ste// zhi ba rin chen gling du skyel mdzad pa// kun gyi ded dpon khyed la kun nas 'dud// sems can las kyi chu bor nub gyur rnams// dam chos bdud rtsi'i zam pas sgrol mdzad cing*// 'phags lam yan lag brgyad la sbyor mdzad pa// gsung gi mnga' bdag khyod la= /smra bsam brjod med shes rab pha rol phyin// ma skyes mi 'gag nam mkha'i ngo bo nyid// so so rang rig ye shes spyod yul ba// dus gsum rgyal ba'i yum la= /mdo sde dbyangs bsnyad lung bstan tshigs su bcad// ched brjod gling bzhi rtogs brjod de ltar byung*// skyes rab rgyas dang rmad byung gtan la dbab// gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis la phyag 'tshal// rlabs chen spyod pa'i tshul ni rab bzung nas// bsdu ba rnam bzhis 'gro don mdzad gyur pa// rab dga' la sogs sa la bzhugs pa yi// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la= /mi 'khrugs pa dang snang mdzad spyan ras gzigs// rin chen 'od 'phro ri rab mu khyud dang*// 'od dpag med dang rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// mthu stobs chen po brgyad la= /bzang skyong zla 'od gzhon nu yul 'khor skyong*// don zab dgongs 'grel kun 'dri chos 'phags dang*// blo gros dag yangs don dam yang dag 'phags// yon tan 'byung gnas rnams la=

/thub pa'i bka' 'khor shā ri'i bu dang ni// mau gal bu dang kun shes nor sbyin 'dzin// nye ba 'khor dang ma 'gags rab 'byor sogs// dgra bcom grangs las 'das la= /rgyun zhugs phyir 'ong phyir mi 'ong la sogs// dgra bcom rigs gyur skyes bu zung bzhi dang*// tshogs na spyod dang bse ru lta bu yi// 'phags pa rang rgyal rnams la= /bkra shis 'byung dang byang chub chen po dang*// chos 'khor cho 'phrul chen po lha las babs// dbyen bsdums sku tshe'i 'du byed byin gyis brlabs// myang 'das mchod rten rnams la= /ston pas bstan pa yongs gtad 'od srung che// kun dga' bo dang sha na'i gos can dang*// nye sbas dhi ti ka dang nag po dang*// legs mthong rnams la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// gsang sngags zab mo'i rnal 'byor la brtson pas// tshe gcig phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub brnyes// ind+ra bhū ti sa ra ha la sogs// dpag yas grub chen rnams la= /mgon po klu sgrub ārya de ba dang*// thogs med dbyig gnyen phyogs glang chos kyi grags// chos skyong yon tan 'od dang dpa' bo sogs// 'dzam gling rgyan mchog rnams la= /sdom brtson dam pa dpal ldan zhi ba 'tsho// brtul zhugs grub pa padma 'byung gnas dpal// blo gsal dbang po padma'i ngang tshul sogs// snyigs dus rgyal ba rnams la= /mi yi dbang po chos bzhin sa skyong ba// rnam dpyod blo can des pas 'gro ba 'dul// dpa' mdzangs blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor ba// rgyal blon byang sems rnams la= /bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs bla na med// zhu chen sgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas 'dug pa'i// skad gnyis smra ba blo gros gsal ldan pa// lo tsā chen po rnams la= /'dzam bu'i gling du bstan pa'i srog shing btsugs// kha ba can du chos kyi sgron me sbar// ngur smrig 'dzin pa shākya'i sras gcig pu// mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho la=

/byang chub sems dpa' chos rgyal tshul 'dzin cing*// gangs can khrod 'dir gdul bya ma lus pa// sna tshogs thabs kyis 'dul bar mdzad pa yi// khri srong lde'u btsan zhabs la= /rig pa'i gnas lnga dag la mkhyen pa rgyas// sgrol mas lung bstan kha ba can du byon// lnga brgya'i dus su thams cad mkhyen par gyur// 'gro mgon a ti sha la= /ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa shākya shrī// rgya gar bod dang kha che la sogs pa// sna tshogs yul du dam chos rgyas mdzad pa'i// paṇa chen yab sras rnams la= /gzungs sngags rtog pa bya rgyud spyod rgyud dang*// rnal 'byor rgyud dang rnal 'byor bla med kyi// dbang lung bshad pa lag len man ngag gi// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la= /so thar byang sems gsang sngags sdom pa dang*// 'dul ba mngon pa mdo sde rin po che// legs par gsungs dang de yi dgongs 'grel gyi// brgyud pa'i bla ma rnams la= /'gro la phan bde ma lus 'byung ba'i gzhi// bde gshegs bstan pa yun ring gnas pa dang*// 'dzin dang spel dang srung dang rgyas mdzad pa'i// skyes bu dam pa rnams la= /rdo rje'i rang bzhin gnas mchog dam pa nas// mngon shes rdzu 'phrul mnga' ba'i thugs rje yis// sgrub pa po la ma yengs bu bzhin skyong*// gnas gsum mkha' 'gro'i tshogs la= /sa bcu nyid la gnas pa'i sems dpa' yang*// gzi brjid me ltar 'bar ba'i khro tshul gyis// bstan la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rtsad nas gcod// ye shes mgon po'i tshogs la= /gang gi 'phrul dang mngon par mkhyen pa'i dpal// nye bar dgongs nas thub pa'i bka' bzhin du// bstan pa rin chen bang mdzod legs skyong ba'i// rdo rje'i chos skyong rnams la= /nor gyi dbang phyug rin chen gter mnga' zhing*// gnod sbyin nor 'chang mang po kun gyi rje// byang phyogs skyong ba'i mgon po dzambha la// dngos grub mchog stsol mdzad la= /gang sngon sbyin pa rgya mtsho'i dge bsags pas// tshe dang nor dang mthu yi dpal brnyes shing*// sgrub pa po la dbyig gi char 'bebs pa'i// gnod sbyin nor skyong rnams la=

/tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs phyogs skyong bcu// rgyal chen bzhi sogs gtsang ris mgon po ste// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes 'phags pa'i tshogs// dkar phyogs skyong ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// ston pa bla med sangs rgyas rin po che// skyob pa bla med dam chos rin po che// 'dren pa bla med dge 'dun rin po che// bla med dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis rten cing 'brel bar 'byung*// 'gag pa med pa skye med pa// chad pa med pa rtag med pa// 'ong ba med pa 'gro med pa// tha dad don min don gcig min// spros pa nyer zhi zhi bstan pa// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas smra rnams kyi// dam pa de la phyag 'tshal lo// rtog pa'i drwa ba rnams bsal zhing*// zab dang rgya che'i sku mnga' ba// kun tu bzang po'i 'od zer dag /kun nas 'phro la= /skyon gyis ma gos sku mdog dkar// rdzogs sangs rgyas kyis dbu la brgyan// thugs rje'i spyan gyis 'gro la gzigs// spyan ras gzigs la= /sangs rgyas kun gyi rab tu bsngags// yon tan dam pa kun gyis brgyan// spyan ras gzigs zhes mtshan gsol ba// rtag par brtse la= /gzhon nu'i sku lus 'chang ba po// ye shes sgron me rab brgyan cing*// 'jig rten gsum gyi mun sel ba// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la= /stobs po che la drag shul che// rig sngags rgyal po dge ba po// gdul dka' mtha' dag 'dul mdzad pa// rdo rje bsnams la= /byang chub sems kyi gzhi rnams dang*// mchod rten rnams la bdag phyag 'tshal// mkhan po de bzhin slob dpon dang*// brtul zhugs mchog la'ang phyag 'tshal lo// phyag byar 'os pa thams cad la// zhing rdul kun gyi grangs snyed kyi// lus btud pa yis rnam kun tu// mchog tu dad pas phyag 'tshal lo// bcu gcig pa bstod pa ni/ rdul gcig steng na rdul snyed sangs rgyas rnams// sangs rgyas sras kyi dbus na bzhugs pa dag

/de ltar chos kyi dbyings rnams ma lus pa// thams cad rgyal ba dag gis gang bar mos// de dag bsngags pa mi zad rgya mtsho rnams// dbyangs kyi yan lag rgya mtsho'i sgra kun gyis// rgyal ba kun gyi yon tan rab brjod cing*// bde bar gshegs pa thams cad bdag gis bstod// gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid// skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*// bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku// rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud// sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku// rdo rje 'dzin pa'i ngo bo nyid// dkon mchog gsum gyi rtsa ba ste// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i sku ni rdo rje'i sku// mdzes shing lta bas mchog mi shes// bsam gyis mi khyab yon tan ldan// bla ma'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo// bla ma'i gsung ni tshangs pa'i dbyangs// 'gag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan// mu stegs ri dwags skrag mdzad pa// bla ma'i gsung la= /bla ma'i thugs ni nam mkha' ltar// bde gsal mi rtog stong pa'i ngang*// rnam thar gsum la legs gnas pa'i// bla ma'i thugs la= /bla ma sangs rgyas bla ma chos// de bzhin bla ma dge 'dun te// kun gyi byed po bla ma yin// bla ma rnams la= /mgon po thugs rje che ldan pa// thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa po// bsod nams yon tan rgya mtsho'i zhing*// de bzhin gshegs la= /dag pa'i 'dod chags bral ba'i rgyu// dge bas ngan song las grol zhing*// gcig tu don dam mchog gyur pa'i// zhi gyur chos la= /grol nas grol ba'i lam yang ston// bslab pa dag la rab tu gus// zhing gi dam pa yon tan zhing*// dge 'dun la yang phyag 'tshal lo// rgya gar skad du/ e ka gā thā/ bod skad du/ tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// skyes bu khyu mchog khyod 'dra'i dge sbyong chen po gzhan dag lha yul sa la'ang med// 'jig rten 'di na'ang yod ma yin rnam thos bu yi gnas na'ang yod ma yin// lha yi pho brang gnas mchog dag na'ang med la phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag na'ang med// ri dang nags su bcas pa'i sa steng rgyas pa kun tu bskor kyang ga la yod// tshigs su bcad pa gcig pa rdzogs so//

༈ /ston pa bcom ldan 'das la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bstod pa ni/ thabs mkhas thugs rjes shākya'i rigs su 'khrungs// gzhan gyis mi thub bdud kyi dpung 'joms pa// gser gyi lhun po lta bur brjid pa'i sku// shākya'i rgyal po khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das thub pa'i dbang po la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis dang por byang chub thugs bskyed nas// bsod nams ye shes tshogs gnyis rdzogs mdzad cing*// dus 'dir mdzad pa rgya chen 'gro ba yi// mgon gyur khyod la bdag gis bstod par gyi// lha rnams 'dul mdzad gdul ba'i dus mkhyen nas// lha las bab nas glang chen ltar gshegs te// rigs la gzigs nas lha mo sgyu 'phrul gyi// lhums su zhugs par mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// zla ba bcu rdzogs shākya'i sras po de// bkra shis lumbe'i tshal tu bltams pa'i tshe// tshangs dang brgya byin gyis bstod mtshan mchog ni// byang chub rigs su nges la= /gzhon nu stobs ldan mi yi seng ge de// aṅga ma ga dhār ni sgyu rtsal bstan// skye bo dregs pa can rnams tshar bcad nas// 'gran zla med par mdzad la phyag= /'jig rten spyod dang mthun par bya ba dang*// kha na ma tho spang phyir btsun mo yi// 'khor dang ldan mdzad thabs la mkhas pa yis// rgyal srid skyong bar mdzad la= /'khor ba'i bya bar snying po med gzigs nas// khyim nas byung ste mkha' la gshegs nas kyang*// mchod rten rnam dag drung du nyid las nyid// rab tu byung bar mdzad la= /brtson pas byang chub 'grub par dgongs nas ni// nai rā ñdza na'i 'gram du lo drug tu// dka' ba spyad nas brtson 'grus mthar phyin te// bsam gtan mchog brnyes mdzad la= /thog ma med nas 'bad pa don yod phyir// ma ga dhā yi byang chub shing drung du// skyil krung mi g.yo mngon par sangs rgyas nas// byang chub rdzogs par mdzad la= /thugs rjes 'gro la myur du gzigs nas ni// wā rā ṇa sī la sogs gnas mchog tu// chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nas gdul bya rnams// theg pa gsum la 'god mdzad=

/gzhan gyi rgol ba ngan pa tshar gcad phyir// mu stegs ston pa drug dang lhas byin sogs// 'khor mo 'jig gi yul du bdud rnams btul// thub pa g.yul rgyal mdzad la= /srid pa gsum na dpe med yon tan gyis// mnyan du yod par cho 'phrul chen po bstan// lha mi 'gro ba kun gyis rab mchod pas// bstan pa rgyas par mdzad la= /le lo can rnams myur du bskul ba'i phyir// rtswa mchog grong gi sa gzhi gtsang ma ru// 'chi med rdo rje lta bu'i sku bshig nas// mya ngan 'da' bar mdzad la= /yang dag nyid du 'jig pa med phyir dang*// ma 'ongs sems can bsod nams 'thob bya'i phyir// de nyid du ni ring bsrel mang sprul nas// sku gdung cha brgyad mdzad la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar bstan pa'i bdag po bcom ldan gyi// mdzad pa'i tshul la mdo tsam bstod pa yi// dge bas 'gro ba kun gyi spyod pa yang*// bde gshegs nyid kyi spyod dang mtshungs par shog /ston pa bcom ldan 'das la mdzad pa bcu gnyis kyi sgo nas bstod pa 'di slob dpon chen po 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// ༈ /bskal bzang sangs rgyas stong gi bstod pa ni/ mthun pa'i smon lam dge tshogs rmad byung bas// spyad pa spyod tshe na yang mched gyur la// bskal bzang gcig la mdzad pa mthar phyin pa'i// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stong la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas spyi'i bstod pa ni/ sems can rnams la brtse ba can// phrad dang bral ba'i dgongs pa can// mi 'bral bde ba'i dgongs pa can// phan bde dgongs khyod la phyag 'tshal// thub pa'i sgrib kun nges par grol// 'jig rten thams cad zil gyis gnon// khyod kyi mkhyen pas shes bya khyab// thugs grol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// sems can rnams ni thams cad kyi// nyon mongs ma lus thams cad 'dul// nyon mongs 'joms mdzad nyon mongs la// brtser bcas khyod la= /lhun gyis grub cing chags mi mnga'// thogs pa mi mnga' rtag par ni// mnyam par gzhag cing 'dri kun gyi// lan ldog khyod la=

/rten dang brten pa bshad bya dang*// gsung dang mkhyen pa 'chad byed la// blo gros rtag thogs mi mnga' bas// legs ston khyod la= /gshegs nas spyod pa mkhyen mdzad de// de dag skad gyis sems can gyi// 'ong dang 'gro dang nges 'byung la// legs 'doms khyod la= /lus can rnams kyis khyod mthong na// skyes bu dam pa lags par 'tshal// mthong ba tsam gyis rab dang bar// mdzad pa khyod la= /len dang gnas dang gtong pa dang*// sprul dang yongs su bsgyur ba dang*// ting nge 'dzin dang ye shes la// mnga' brnyes khyod la= /thabs dang skyabs dang dag pa dang*// theg chen nges par 'byung ba la// sems can rnams ni rab bslu ba'i// bdud 'joms khyod la= /rang gzhan don du ye shes dang*// spangs dang nges 'byung gegs byed rnams// ston mdzad mu stegs gzhan dag gis// mi brdzi khyod la= /bsrung med bsnyel ba mi mnga' bas// 'khor gyi nang du bag rkyong gsung*// kun nas nyon mongs gnyis spangs pas// 'khor sdud khyod la= /kun mkhyen khyod la rgyu ba dang*// gnas pa kun la rtag par ni// kun mkhyen min spyod mi mnga' bar// yang dag don ldan khyod phyag 'tshal// sems can rnams kyi bya ba la// khyod ni dus las mi 'da' bas// mdzad pa rtag tu don mnga' ba// mi bsnyel khyod la= /'jig rten kun la nyin mtshan du// lan drug tu ni so sor gzigs// thugs rje chen po dang ldan pa// phan dgongs khyod la= /spyod pa dang ni rtogs pa dang*// ye shes dang ni phrin las kyis// nyan thos rang sangs rgyas kun gyi// bla ma khyod la= /sku gsum dag gis byang chub che// rnam pa kun brnyes thams cad du// sems can kun gyi the tshom dag /gcod pa khyod la= /'dzin pa med cing nyes pa med// rnyog pa med cing mi gnas pa// mi g.yo chos rnams thams cad la// spros med khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa 'di ni rgyal tshab byams pa mgon po nas mdzad pa'i theg pa chen po mdo sde rgyan gyi mthar thug gi le'u nyi shu rtsa gcig pa las gsungs so// de'i kha bskong chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas mdzad pa ni/

thob bya'i yon tan kun brnyes pas// rang dang gzhan gyi phrin las sgrub// mkhyen par bya ba'i chos rnams kun// ma lus gzigs pa khyod phyag 'tshal// dran dang brtson 'grus ting nge 'dzin// rmad du byung ba'i dbang po stobs// byang chub yan lag 'phags pa'i lam// legs sgrub khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// khams gsum gtogs pa'i rnam par rtog /spangs pa'i snyoms 'jug rnam dgu yis// sems kyi tha ba 'joms pa'i dbang*// mthar son khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// gnyis su 'dzin pas rab stong zhing*// nye bar len la smon mi mnga'// mtshan ma thams cad rab zhi bas// rnam thar mchog brnyes khyod phyag 'tshal// ye shes dang ni thugs rje la// bskal pa du mar thugs sbyangs pas// nye bar 'tshe ba'i bdud sde rnams// legs 'dul khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// phyi dang nang dang gnyis ka dang*// 'dun dang mkhyen dang 'doms pa la// dbang bcu dag gis 'jig rten gyi// bya ba sgrub pa khyod phyag 'tshal// rmad byung lhun gyis grub pa can// shes bya kun la thogs med pa// sgrub dang spong ba'i ting 'dzin la// mnga' brnyes khyod la= /'dzin dang 'chad pa chos kyi sgo// nyung ngus chos rnams bde blag tu// ston mdzad gzungs kyis chos kyi gter// khang byed khyod la= /chags sogs dgag dka'i dri ma dang*// 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa'i gzhi// bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs la// sgrib pa kun grol khyod phyag 'tshal// gsal dang dri med yon tan gter// phrin las rten dang brten pa yis// rang gzhan don gyi ye shes la// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khyed phyag 'tshal// gsung dbyangs mi 'jigs seng ge'i sgra// yan lag drug cu dang ldan pas// lhar bcas 'jig rten thams cad la// legs sgrogs khyod la= /khyod kyis zag bcas 'gro ba'i rgyun// gang lags lam gyi bden pas bsgyur// 'gro ba kun 'jug ye shes su// mkhyen pa khyod la=

/'jig rten slob ma bse ru sras// ston pa'i 'byor pa phul byung ba// gang lags de 'dra mnga' brnyes pas// legs 'byor khyod la= /thun mong ba dang phul byung chos// rlabs chen shin tu rmad byung ba// brnyes pas 'jig rten thams cad kyi// skyabs gyur khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de lta'i dngos bstod ston pa yis// bstan pa rin chen gsal mdzad pa// 'gro ba kun gyis shes bya yi// de nyid legs par mthong bar shog /ces pa 'di ni thub pa dgongs gsal las phyung ba'o// de bzhin gshegs pa khyed sku ci 'dra dang*// 'khor dang sku tshe'i tshad dang zhing khams sogs// khyed kyi mtshan mchog bzang po ci 'dra ba// de 'dra kho nar bdag sogs 'gyur bar shog/ ༈ /thub dbang cho 'phrul bstod pa bzhugs so// mnyan yod gnas su ston la mu stegs kyi// ston pa drug gis cho 'phrul 'gran pa'i tshe// skye bo du ma tshogs pa'i mngon sum du// rmad byung cho 'phrul bstan la phyag 'tshal lo// tshes gcig gsal rgyal gyis ni mchod pa'i tshe// tshems shing sa la btsugs pas ljon shing skyes// dpag tshad lnga brgyar khyab pa'i yal 'dab rgyas// dri ros skye bo tshim la phyag= /tshes gnyis u dra yā nas mchod pa'i tshe// g.yas g.yon gnyis su rin chen rig gnyis sprul// ri rtse las skyes 'bras dang rtswa rnams kyis// mi dang dud 'gro tshim la= /tshes gsum shuñtsa yā nas mchod pa'i tshe// zhal bsil chu las rin chen rdzing bur sprul// kha dog sna tshogs padma'i 'od zer gyis// dri yis tshim par mdzad la= /tshes bzhir ind+ra wa nas mchod pa'i tshe// phyogs bzhir yur ba brgyad ldan rdzing bur sprul// chu yi sgra las tshad med bzhi la sogs// chos kyi sgra snyan ston la= /tshes lngar tshangs byin gyis ni mchod pa'i tshe// zhal gyi sgo nas 'od zer sna tshogs bkye// 'od de rig pas sgrib pa rnams dang bral// lus sems bde ba bskyed la=

/tshes drug litstsha rnams kyi mchod pa'i tshe// sangs rgyas mthu yis phan tshun bsam pa shes// rab tu dga' nas ston pa'i yon tan brjod// so sor smon lam 'debs la= /tshes bdun shākya rnams kyis mchod pa'i tshe// ston pa'i mthu yis 'khor gyi sems can rnams// rgyal por gyur nas rin chen bdun sogs ldan// kun kyang spro zhing tshim la= /tshes brgyad brgya byin gyis ni mchod pa'i tshe// seng ge'i khri la glang chen sgra skad dang*// srin po lnga dang phyag na rdo rjer sprul// mu stegs ston pa skrag mdzad= /tshes dgur tshangs pa'i rgyal pos mchod pa'i tshe// tshangs pa'i bar du khyab pa'i sku sprul te// sku las 'od zer chen po byung gyur pa// kun gyis gsal bar mthong la= /tshes bcu rgyal chen bzhi yis mchod pa'i tshe// srid rtse'i bar du khyab pa'i sku sprul nas// 'od zer chen po snang zhing gsal bar mdzad// kun gyis mthong zhing gsung ston= /bcu gcig zas sbyin gyis ni mchod pa'i tshe// ston pa seng ge'i khri la bzhugs bzhin du// sku ni mi mngon 'od zer phung por gyur// gsung gis chos ston mdzad la= /bcu gnyis khyim bdag tsintas mchod pa'i tshe// lte ba'i 'od kyis stong gsum bar du ni// padma'i steng na sangs rgyas bzhugs pa sprul// kun kyang de ltar sprul la phyag= /bcu gsum rgyal po shuñtsas mchod pa'i tshe// sku yi 'od kyis stong gsum bar du khyab// 'od de reg pas sgrib pa rnams dang bral// rtsa sogs 'bras bu thob la phyag= /bcu bzhir rgyal po u dras mchod pa'i tshe// rgyal pos gtor ba'i me tog thams cad kyang*// rin chen shing rtas stong gsum bar du khyab// kun gyis gsal bar mthong la= /bco lngar gzugs can snying pos mchod pa'i tshe// ro brgya ldan pa'i zas kyis snod kun bkang*// phyag mthil sa la brdabs pas dmyal ba yis// sems can dpag med grol la phyag 'tshal lo// mtshungs med ston pa'i cho 'phrul sna tshogs la// cung zad tsam zhig bdag gis bstod pa yis// dge ba cung zad dag gis ci bsags pa// cho 'phrul che ldan rgyal ba'i sku thob shog

/byang pa rigs ldan gyis mdzad pa'o// 'dir spro zhing nus na kun mkhyen bu ston gnyis pa zhwa lu mchog sprul blo gsal zhabs kyi thub dbang mdzad brgya'i bstod pa 'don// ༈ /rje btsun byams pa mgon po la bstod pa theg mchog gnad kyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na ma ārya mai tri nā thā ya/ byams pa'i dkyil 'khor chos dbyings mkha' la 'char// mkhyen pa'i nyi 'od gdul bya padmo'i gnyen// srid zhi'i mun pa stong gis ma pham pa// rgyal tshab chos kyi nyi ma de la 'dud// chags pa'i skyon bral padmo'i lte bar ni// thugs rje'i cha shas yongs rdzogs zla gdan la// sems can don la dgyes pa'i sku mchog ni// gser bzang mdog can rnam par 'gying la 'dud// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pa thugs kar ni// grangs med chos kyi sgo rnams 'byed pa'i tshul// phyag g.yon ting 'dzin bye ba rgyas mdzad pa'i// mnyam gzhag phyag rgyas bzhugs pa de la 'dud// rab mdzes padmo'i lte bar spyi blugs kyi// ze'u 'bru rnam par rgyas pa'i rtse mor ni// zur phud lnga ldan lcang lo 'khyil pa yi// bung ba gzhon nu rol pa de la 'dud// bimba ltar dmar mchu sgros yid 'ong zhing*// kha ba ltar dkar mdzod spu g.yas su 'khyil// mig sman ltar gnag ral pa'i thor cog ni// chos sku'i rten gyis mdzes par byas la 'dud// lang tsho'i dpal yon rgyas pa'i ljon pa la// mtshan gyi me tog dpe byad ze'u 'brus spras// rin chen mchog gi 'bras bu'i chun 'phyang can// sna tshogs dar gyi na bzas mdzes la 'dud// nyi ma 'bum gyi mdangs las gsal ba yi// rnam bkra 'od kyi 'phro 'du'i skad cig la// 'gro ba'i las nyon tshang tshing kun bsal nas// ye shes snang ba rgyas par mdzad la 'dud// nye ring kun la snyoms pa tshangs pa'i dbyangs// thar lam ston pa lha yi rnga bo che// skye med 'gag pa med pa brag ca'i gsung*// yan lag drug cu'i dbyangs ldan de la 'dud// chos nyid dag pa gnyis ldan mngon du gyur// chos can ji snyed dbye ba so sor gzigs// chos rnams rnam kun mngon rdzogs byang chub pa// sgrib bral rnam par dag pa'i thugs la 'dud// stobs nyid rdo rje mi 'jigs seng ge bzhin// ma 'dres mkha' dag thub bstan chu zla ltar// bral dang rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu yi// yon tan drug cu bzhis brgyan de la 'dud// brgya byin rnga sgra tshangs nyi yid bzhin nor// sgra brnyan nam mkha' sa bzhin srid mtha'i bar// 'bad med lhun gyis grub pa'i mdzad pa ni// rgyun mi chad par 'jug pa de la 'dud// gus pas phyag 'tshal kun bzang mchod sprin 'bul// sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rangs// chos 'khor bskor bzhin brtan par bzhugs su gsol// rab dkar dge tshogs byang chub mchog tu bsngo// dpag med yon tan gter mnga' mgon khyed la// mtha' med 'gro ba srid las bsgral ba'i phyir// yengs med rtse gcig yid kyis gsol 'debs kyis// dmigs med byams pa'i thugs kyis dgongs su gsol// khams gsum 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal rgyu bcas kun// dus gsum rtag tu bdag la blangs byas nas// sgo gsum 'bad pas bsags pa'i bde dge rnams// khams gsum 'gro la smin par byin gyis rlobs// pha rol phyin drug spyod pa'i go bgos nas// yang dag lta ba'i nyams myong gsal ba yis// rang bzhin dag pa'i gnas lugs mngon gyur te// bag chags spong phyir sgom par byin gyis rlobs// sgrib gnyis sprin bral chos dbyings nam mkha' la// sku gsum nyin byed dkyil 'khor rab rgyas te// phrin las tsha zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba yis// 'gro la lam bzang ston par byin gyis rlobs// gnas skabs kun tu mgon po khyod nyid kyi// gsung gi dgongs pa 'khrul med legs rtogs nas// lhag bsam dag pas phyogs bcur spel ba yis// theg mchog bstan pa rgyas par byin gyis rlobs// tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par gyur ma thag

/dga' ldan gnas su thugs rje'i phyag gis drongs// ji srid sa rab dga' ba thob bar du// dam chos bdud rtsis tshim par byin gyis rlobs// mdor na sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// thugs kyi dgongs pa legs tshogs ji snyed kun// bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus la// myur du 'grub par byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rgyal ba mi pham mgon po la bstod pa theg mchog gnad kyi sgo 'byed ces bya ba 'di ni/ khro phu'i byams chen la gsol ba 'debs pa'i don du bya bral pa bsod nams seng ges sbyar ba'o// ༈ /byams pa mgon po'i rnam thar dang mthun par bstod cing byams chos lam rim rgyud la skye bar gsol ba 'debs pa ma pham dgongs rgyan bzhugs/ oṃ bde legs su gyur cig /dpal ldan phun tshogs nyin mor byed pa'i sku// mdangs gsal 'od kyi drwa bas phyogs kun mdzes// srid zhi'i rgud pa sel ba'i snang brnyan can// byams mgon nam mkha'i nor bur phyag bgyi'o// mgon khyod sngon tshe gser mdog can zhes pa'i// rgyal por gyur tshe ston pa gser bzang 'od// 'khor bcas lo grangs bye ba brgyad cu bzhir// mchod cing thugs mchog dang por bskyed la 'dud// 'dren pa rin chen gdugs kyi bstan pa la// dge slong blo gros brtan par gyur pa'i tshe// nyin re bzhin yang srog chags brgya phrag re// bslab pa'i gzhi lnga 'dzin par bkod la 'dud// khyod zhabs gang du gnas pa'i grong khyer de'i// 'khor bcas ston pas khyed mtshan byams pa zhes// ma 'ongs rgyal bar lung bstan brnyes la 'dud// tog dkar 'dzam gling gshegs tshe gang de yi// rin chen cod pan khyod la legs bcings te// thub pa'i rgyal tshab mchog tu dbang thob nas// dga' ldan theg chen chos kyi skyong la 'dud// ma 'ongs skye dgu tshe lo brgyad khri bar// gyur tshe 'dzam gling dbus 'dir bram ze'i rigs// mchog tu dga' ba zhes byar khyod 'khrungs nas// byang chub dam pa mngon du mdzad la 'dud// de tshe tshangs bzang tshangs bdag yab dang yum// bsod nams stobs sras ye shes 'od dang ni// brtson 'grus brtan par shes rab rdzu 'phrul can// rgya mtshos rim gro mdzad 'gyur khyod la 'dud// lo grangs brgyad khri bzhi stong brtan bzhugs nas// 'dus pa gsum la chos 'khor gsum bskor te// slar yang lo grangs brgyad khri'i bar dag tu// dam chos rin chen gnas par mdzad la 'dud// gus pas phyag 'tshal mchod sprin rgya mtshos mchod// sdig pa kun bshags dge la rjes yi rangs// chos 'khor bskor bzhin rtag par bzhugs gsol 'debs// dge tshogs byang chub chen po thob phyir bsngo// nam zhig bdag cag 'chi ba'i dus byed tshe// byams chen thugs rje'i phyag gi legs drangs nas// dga' ldan chos kyi pho brang der skyes nas// ma pham dgos pa'i 'dzum zhal mthong bar shog

/der yang rje btsun mchog gi yon tan la// dmigs pa'i dad gus rnam 'gyur sngon 'gro bas// lha rdzas mchod pa'i sprin phung bsam yas kyis// byams chen rgyal ba 'khor bcas mnyes byed shog /deng nas bzung ste tshe rabs thams cad du// khyed kyi 'khor gyi thog mar bdag gyur nas// bdud dang gshin rje'i spyod yul las 'das te// theg chen chos kyi dpal la spyod par shog /mkhyen pa rnams gsum thos dang bsam pa yis// sgro 'dogs chod nas phun tshogs sbyor ba bzhis// nyams su blangs pas rnam grol chos kyi sku// rang gzhan don gnyis mthar phyin thob par shog /theg chen rigs sad chos la mos pa'i blos// sems bskyed sbyin sogs sgrub cing skyon med 'jug /sems can yongs su smin byed zhing khams sbyangs// mi gnas myang 'das byang chub che ston shog /rten cing 'brel bar 'byung ba gzhan gyi dbang*// gzung dang 'dzin pa kun brtags kyis stong pa'i// chos nyid yongs su grub pa dbu ma'i lam// mtha' gnyis spangs pa'i don mchog rtogs par shog /kun rdzob 'khor ba'i rtog pas ma gos pa'i// don dam mya ngan 'das pa'i lam chen po// rtag dang chad pa'i mtshan ma las grol ba'i// chos can chos nyid rnam dbye 'byed mkhas shog /rin chen dkon mchog gsum la brten pa'i mthus// bde gshegs khams kyi dri ma kun byang nas// byang chub yon tan kun ldan mngon gyur te// lhun grub phrin las rgyun mi chad thob shog /bcom ldan 'das mgon po byams pas rnam thar dang mthun par bstod cing*/ byams chos kyi lam rim rgyud la skye bar gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa ma pham dgongs rgyan zhes bya ba 'di ni/ tshe rabs thams cad du rgyal ba de nyid kyi bka' 'bangs su skye bar 'dun zhing smon pa'i blo can mang du thos pa'i btsun pa dkon mchog lhun grub kyis e waṃ chos ldan du gsol ba btab pa'o// ji ltar smon pa bzhin du 'grub par gyur cig

/de de bzhin du gyur cig /de las gzhan du ma gyur cig/ ༈ /'jam dbyangs kyi bstod pa rgyud gsum 'khor lo bzhugs/ mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag byas nas// dus gsum rgyal ba kun gyi yab gyur pa'i// 'jam dpal 'jam dbyangs 'jam pa'i rdo rje la// dad pas bstod pa 'di ni brjod par bgyi// drag po 'phrog byed dbyig gi snying po dang*// sred byed mig stong gtsug gi nor bu yis// 'jam mgon zhabs kyi 'dam skyes rtag mchod pa// bdag kyang khyod kyi zhabs rdul spyi bos len// sangs rgyas kun gyis rtag tu rab bsngags shing*// sa bcu'i rgyal sras rnams dang rang rgyal gtso// dgra bcom chen po kun gyi rtag bstod mod// bdag kyang snyan ngag me tog snyim pas mchod// rgyal ba kun gyis rtag tu dgongs gyur cing*// 'phags pa'i tshogs kyi the tshom gcod pa po// skye dgu rnams kyi skyabs gyur bcom ldan 'das// dad pas rtag tu bdag ni skyabs su mchi// btso ma gser dang gur gum mdangs 'dra zhing*// ral gri utpal glegs bam gyis mdzes pa// ral pa'i cod pan rin chen dar gyis brgyan// sna tshogs gdan steng brjid pas bzhugs la 'dud// rab dkar anda rnyil dang margad mtshungs// li khri'i mdog mtshungs phyed gzugs du ma'i mdangs// nam mkha'i khams kun gom pa gcig gis gnon// phyag mtshan du mas sgeg la bdag phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas thams cad skyed pa'i yab gyur kyang*// byis pa'i gzugs 'dzin gzhon nu'i mtshan ldan zhing*// rab bgres 'jig rten dbang phyug rdo rje 'dzin// kun gyis bla mar mdzad la mgos phyag 'tshal// 'jam pa'i mtshan ldan rab tu zhi ba yis// mtha' yas sems can tshogs rnams bsgral mod kyi// gdug cing gtum pa'i 'gro ba bsgral ba'i phyir// gshin rje 'joms mdzad khyod la mgos phyag 'tshal// khyod sku khros pa'i rnam 'phrul mtha' yas mdzod// gang mthong khro bo kun gyi lag cha shor// bdud dang log 'dren kun gyi snying rab gas// ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal skem pa'i dpal la 'dud// la lar dkyil 'khor gtso bo la lar 'khor// la lar sangs rgyas gyur nas zhing rnams skyong*// rgyal ba'i sras la sangs rgyas sprul pa 'gyed// zhing khams du ma ba spu'i bu gar snang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom dang ni brtul zhugs bzang*// la lar tshangs dbang 'jug sel la sogs pa// rnam 'phrul mtha' yas mdzad pa du ma yis// ma lus sems can don mdzad khyed la 'dud// 'jam pa'i gsung ldan rig byed dran pa'i dbyangs// yi ge lnga ni chos rnams kun gyi sgo// blo mchog yi ge gcig pa'i gsung gis ni// 'gro ba mtha' dag sgrol la mgos phyag 'tshal// oṃ gyi nga ro 'jam pas rab drangs nas// drag po'i yi ge sum bcu gnyis la sogs// rab zab rig sngags du ma'i tshogs rnams kyis// gdug pa'i tshogs 'joms dbyangs la bdag phyag 'tshal// chos sku rab tu zhi ba 'jam pa'i ngang*// gnyis med longs spyod rdzogs pa rdo rje'i sku// zung 'jug thugs rje chen pos 'gro don mdzad// ye shes lnga yi thugs la bdag phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i klung gi bye snyed kyi// mtshan rnams bskal par brjod pa'i bsod nams pas// 'jam dpal lan gcig brjod pa ches mchog ces// bden par gsung gis bdag la byin gyis rlobs// skom pas nyen pa'i 'gro ba du ma zhig

/chu klung chen po'i drung du lhags gyur te// 'thungs pas rab tshim dga' bar gyur mod kyang*// chu la bri bar gyur pa cung zad med// de bzhin 'jam dbyangs chos kyi rgya mtsho la// rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rgyal// skye bo'i tshogs kyis bstod par gyur mod kyang*// yon tan rgya mtsho mi zad khyod la 'dud// srid par 'dod pa'i sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*// rigs can gsum ni rang rang sa la 'jog /kun kyang rim gyis sangs rgyas sar 'jog pa'i// phrin las mtha' yas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo// de ltar 'jam dbyangs bstod pa'i bsod nams kyis// mkha' mnyam sems can kun gyi snang ba la// 'jam dbyangs ye shes nyi ma shar gyur te// 'gro ba'i ma rig dpyis 'byin byed par shog /skye bo bdag 'dzin mun pas rab g.yogs nas// spros bral thar pa'i bde gnas mi shes pa// de dag kun la zung 'jug bde ba'i lam// ye shes sgron ma rtag tu ston par shog /byang chub sems kyi rin chen las byung ba'i// bdag kyang blo mchog 'jam dbyangs nyid gyur nas// nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can rnams// dri med sangs rgyas sa la 'jog par shog /rje btsun 'phags pa 'jam pa'i dbyangs kyi bstod pa rgyud gsum gyi 'khor lo zhes bya ba shākya'i dge bsnyen theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis nye bar sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// nyes pa mchis na bla ma dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar bshags shing*/ dge ba rnams sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo'o// ༈ /bla ma dang rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// dpal ldan blo gros dhīḥlas byung ba gzhon nu'i tshul 'chang mdzes pa'i sku// chu skyes bsil zer can dbus skyil mo krung bcas rol pa'i 'gying bag can// gur gum mdog can zur phud lnga pa snyan gong utpal gyis mdzes shing*// sna tshogs rin chen rab spras lha yi na bzas smad g.yogs legs par bgos// phyag g.yas mkha' ltar sngo ba'i ral gri tsha zer can 'od rab 'phros pas// mun pa'i thibs po dral zhing bdud bcom de bzhin nyid don thugs chud cing*// g.yon gyis utpal 'dab brgya rnam rgyas mgul pa'i ngos su rab rgyas pa'i// ge sar snying po dri med steng na rgyal ba'i gsung rab glegs bam bsnams// khyod gtsug mi bskyod skyob pas rab mtshan rdo rje rnon po yi ge drug

/bzhad pa'i gad rgyangs can gyi zhabs rdul yid 'ong bdag gi spyi bor zhog /khyod sku bdag lus snying gi 'khor lor rnam bsams gang gi chags sdang sogs// ngan sems tha chad dam pas smad pa de kun mgon pos bzod mdzad cing*// rgyal sras thu bo'i rnam thar zab cing rgya che bdag la nyer stsol mdzod// yab gcig nyid las lha gzhan dag la re ba ma mchis skal ngan bdag /nyin mtshan kun tu 'jam dbyangs gus pas bsam kyang khyed kyi thugs rje'i shugs// cung zad med snyam 'on kyang byur ngan rang gi nyes pas bslad par zad// da dung khyod mnyes ma gyur bar du skyabs gzhan tshol bar ma gyur cig /bcom ldan 'das mgon po 'jam pa'i rdo rje la mchod par brjod pa'i tshul gyis bstod pa sa skya paṇḍi tas sbyar ba'o// //zhi ba gdong bzhi mig stong ldan pa dang*// dpal mo'i dpal dang klu dbang stobs ldan sogs// 'jig rten mchod 'os rnams kyis gus mchod pa'i// thub dbang zhabs kyi padmor rtag tu 'dud/ thub dbang bstod pa shlau ka 'di gtsang nags phug pas mdzad par grag/ ༈ /rgyan drug gam mchog brgyad kyi bstod pa bzhugs/ oṃ swa sti siddhaṃ/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gzhung lugs mi 'dra'i chu bo brgya 'gyed cing*// rigs tshogs spobs pa'i rba rlabs stong 'phro ba// yon tan rin chen khri phrag gis brgyan pa'i// klu sgrub klu yi dbang po la phyag 'tshal// bsod nams dam pa'i pad rdzing gis bskrun zhing*// smon lam dag pa'i chu skyes las 'khrungs la// srid dang zhi ba'i dpal 'byor gyis 'phagaṃs paṃ// lhaṃ mchog rnams kyi bla mar gyur la 'dud// gang zhig thogs dang thoṃgs bya'i chos rnams kun// 'od gsal chen po'i ngang du chud pas na// gzigs pa sgrib meṃd brtse bas kun chags pa// ji bzhin snang mdzad smra ba'i nyi mar 'dud// mang du sbyangs pas mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// spobs pas shes bya'i mkha' la thogs med rgyu// rig pa'i zer gyis gzhan gzhung tshang tshing sreg

/dbyigaṃ gnyeṃn chos kyi nyi ma la phyag 'tshal// yon tan lus rdzogs spobs pa'i stobs kyis rtsen// rnam dpyod rtsal ldan rig pa'i mche ba can// rgol ba 'dam bu'i grong bzhin rtsad nas 'joms// bstan pa'i khur khyer phyogaṃs glaṃng zhabs la 'dud// lugs bzang ri bo'i spo la gnas bcas shing*// blo gros lus rgyas rig pa'i mche sder gyis// rgol ba glang po'i spobs pa'i klad 'gems pa// choṃs kyiṃ gragaṃs paṃ 'jigs med seng ge rgyal// ring du sbyangs pas shes bya kun mkhyen cing*// brtson pas bsgrubs pas zab mo'i dngos grub brnyes// mthu dang nus pas mu stegs bdud las rgyal// 'jigs med dpaṃl ldaṃn choṃs skyongaṃ zhabs la 'dud// 'dul ba rgya mtsho'i tshogs la dbang 'byor zhing*// dul ba'i yoṃn tanaṃ dpal gyi gzi che bas// 'chal tshul smag rum sel ba'i 'oṃd mdzad pa// lha yi tshogs kyis bstod pa de la 'dud// khyed thugs bskal pa du mar rab sbyangs pas// shes bya ma lus ji bzhin yongs su mkhyen// skad gnyis smra bas gangs can gsal mdzad pa// riṃn cheṃn bzaṃng poṃ'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pa 'di chos rgyal 'phags pas mdzad pa'o// ༈ /bod la bka' drin che ba rnams la bstod pa/ za hor rgyal po'i rigs su sku 'khrungs shing*// thams cad yod smra'i sde las rab tu byung*// nyes ltung dri mas ma gos btsun pa'i mchog /bo dhi sa twa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// sa paṇa gyis mdzad pa'i phyag mtshan ri mo'i bstod tshig las byung ba ni/ sdom brtson dam pa dpal ldan zhi bar 'tsho// brtul zhugs grub pa padma 'byung gnas dpal// blo gsal dbang po padma'i ngang tshul sogs// snyigs ma'i dus kyi rgyal ba gnyis pa yin// bde bar gshegs pa'i ring lugs bla na med// zhu chen sgyur byed mchan bu'i gnas 'dug pa'i// skad gnyis smra ba blo gros gsal ldan pa// de dag bdag cag rnams kyi mig tu gyur// mi yi dbang po chos bzhin sa skyong ba// rnam dpyod blo can nges pas 'gro ba 'dul// dpa' mdzangs blon po'i tshogs kyis yongs bskor te// skye rgu 'di dag bu bzhin legs par bskyangs// bod yul mtha' 'khob mun pa'i smag rum 'dir// dam pa chos kyi sgron me chen po sbar// bod 'bangs sems can bde la 'god mdzad pa// sprul pa'i rgyal blon rnams la gsol ba 'debs// phan bde'i 'byung gnas bslab gsum rgyan gyis mdzes// bka' dang bstan bcos sgra sgyur gtan la 'bebs// sangs rgyas bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas mdzad pa'i// mkhas grub lo paṇa rnams la gsol ba 'debs//

༈ /jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha la bstod pa bzhugs/ phun sum tshogs pa bhaṅga la yi yul// cho rigs btsun pa za hor rgyal po'i rigs// byang chub sems dpa' zhi 'tsho 'khrungs pa'i rgyud// mar me mdzad pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// yab dang yum la sri zhu mkhas shing gus// gzugs mdzes yid 'ong shes rab snying brtser ldan// dul zhing rgyud 'jam thabs mkhas snying stobs che// mar me mdzad pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// 'jig rten lugs kyi bstan bcos thams cad dang*// bzo dang gso ba sgyu rtsal sna tshogs dang*// rig byed kun la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas// mar me mdzad pa'i zhabs la gsol= /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga la ma chags shing*// rgyal srid 'byor pa phun tshogs spangs nas ni// dge 'dun phal chen sde pa'i dge slong mdzad// dpal ldan a ti sha la= /'dul ba'i sde snod sde bzhi las gsungs pa// bde bar gshegs pas bslab pa bcas pa la// nyes pa'i skyon gyis ma gos rnam par dag /dpal ldan a ti sha la= /yongs su 'dzin pa'i mkhas pa mang bsten nas// sde snod gsum dang sgra dang tshad ma dang*// man ngag kun la mkhas shing mkhyen pa rgyas// dpal ldan a ti sha la= /gser gling rgyal po sa skyong bla ma las// byang chub sems kyi bdud rtsi'i sman blangs nas// 'gro ba kun la phan par mdzad pa yi// dpal ldan a ti sha la= /sems can phongs shing shin tu sdug bsngal ba// rab tu mang la snying nas brtse ba yis// 'jig rten lha dang lha min mir bcas pa'i// skyob pa yab gcig po la= /grub pa brnyes pa'i bla ma dam pa las// yi dam lha yi mngon rtogs lung nod nas// rtse gcig sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa yis// lung bstan thob par gyur la= /gdul bya bod du yod par dgongs nas ni// kha ba can gyi ljongs su byon nas kyang*// sde pa mi chen rnams kyi bla ma mdzad// mchod cing bkur 'os khyed la= /mkhas mchog khyed 'dra bod du ma byon na// sangs rgyas bstan pa yod par gyur kyang ni// phal cher zab mo'i don la rmongs gyur pas// legs par ston mdzad khyod la=

/bstan bcos bsgyur dang bsgyur zin 'chos pa dang*// de nyid 'chad dang rang gis rtsom pa sogs// yang dag lam la legs par khrid pa yis// bstan pa rgyas mdzad khyod la= /lta ngan la zhen log pa'i lam la zhugs// bdud dang mu stegs dbang phyug grub mtha' ngan// rigs pas tshar bcad thar pa'i lam la bkod// thar 'dod ded dpon khyed la= /sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab pha rol phyin pa drug /skye ba du mar yang yang goms pa yis// tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs la= /mkho ba sbyin dang snyan par smra ba dang*// 'jig rten don mthun gdul bya'i don la spyod// bsdu ba'i dngos po bzhi yi dpal 'byor gyis// gzhan don lhur mdzad khyod la= /dad dang shes rab thos dang gtong ba dang*// ngo tsha shes dang khrel yod tshul khrims kyi// nor bdun dag gis phyug par gyur pa'i mdzod// yon tan 'byung gnas khyod la= /sngon tshe smon lam btab pa'i slob ma mchog /rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ring nas 'ongs pa'i tshe// u pa si ka de ring sleb bo zhes// lha mig mngon shes mnga' la= /ma ga dhā nas slob ma gus pa yis// sil snyan dkrol zhing gsol ba btab pa'i skad// bod du gsan nas 'brom la sbran pa yi// rna ba'i mngon shes mnga' la= /lha sar lha yis rol mo bsgrags pa las// myur du byon nas bar khang lha tshogs la// phyag rten phul nas mkha' la bskor ba mdzad// rdzu 'phrul mngon shes mnga' la= /gang du rgyal po'i bka' chems gter du sbas// mkha' 'gros gter kha phye nas khyod la gtad// shākya mu ni'i 'ja' sa khyod kyi drin// jo bo bka' drin can la= /sa bdag nad kyis zin pa'i mi rnams la// rtag par tshe 'dzin srung ba'i skor rnams kyang*// khyod las byung ste 'gro ba'i nad gso mdzad// klu sgrub gnyis par grags la= /snye thang 'or du bye ma'i steng bzhugs tshe// brgya byin la sogs bar snang lha tshogs kyis// rin chen sna lnga'i me tog char pa phab// bla ma lha yi lha la=

/g.yor po mching bur bu mos mgo rgyan phul// shi ba gsan nas de yi sgrib sbyong mdzad// rigs kyi bu mo lha ru skyes zhes gsungs// 'gro ba 'dren mdzad khyod la= /kho bo 'di nas dga' ldan gnas su 'gro// nga la dad cing gus par byed pa rnams// dga' ldan gnas su mjal bar 'gyur zhes gsungs// ma 'ongs mngon sum gzigs la= /dga' ldan gnas na nam mkha' dri ma med// 'phags pa'i yul na dī paṃ ka ra shrī// kha ba can 'dir dpal ldan a ti sha// sa steng grags pas khyab la= /'brom ston bdag gis rwa sgrengs lha khang bzhengs// 'gro ba 'dren phyir gsol ba btab pa las// dga' ldan gnas nas rab gnas me tog 'thor// byin rlabs dngos su phebs la= /khyod kyi yon tan thos dang mthong ba las// dwang ba'i yid kyis lhang lhang gsol 'debs na// dga' ldan gnas nas thugs rjes gzigs mdzod la// gsol ba btab bzhin byin gyis brlab tu gsol// da dung kha ba can na khyod nyid la// dad cing rjes su slob pa mang yod kyi// thugs kyis dgongs nas bu la ma bzhin du// brtse bas bdag gi dge bshes mdzad du gsol// snyigs dus skye bo dmus long lta bu rnams// dam min dge ba'i bshes 'dras rjes bzung ste// 'khor ba'i gcong rong gnas nas 'dren med rnams// thugs rje'i lcags kyus myur du drang du gsol// dus dang gnas skabs dag ni thams cad du// dam pa khyed ni bdag gi mgon lags kyi// mngon par rdzogs par myur du 'tshang rgya ba'i// thos bsam sgom gsum bdag la stsal du gsol// zhes pa 'di ni 'brom rin po ches mdzad pa'o// ༈ /yongs kyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen yongs kyi mgon// rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob gyur pa rgyal ba'i sras// rang gzhan don gnyis 'byung gnas rin po che// bshes gnyen ston pa'i zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// bskal pa du mar tshogs gnyis goms pa'i mthus// gnas gsum don la mkhyen pa'i dkyil 'khor rgyas// a ti sha yi sras kyi thu bo pa// legs pa'i shes rab zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// mar me mdzad dpal rgyal ba kun gyi yab// rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba rgya mtsho las// gdams pa'i khu ba ston nas tshim mdzad pa'i// brtson 'grus g.yung drung zhabs la gsol ba 'debs// long med thugs la 'khrungs pa'i pu to ba// bdag pas gzhan ces sgom pa'i spyan snga ba// sgrub pa snying por mdzad pa'i phu chung ba// rgyal sras sku mched gsum la gsol ba 'debs//

༈ /paṇa chen shākya shrī brgyud pa dang bcas pa la bstod pa bzhugs/ lnga rig paṇa chen mtshungs med chos kyi rje// chos 'dul bod kyis gangs can snang mdzad pa// ma byon sangs rgyas gsum pa skye rgu'i mgon// thugs rje'i bdag nyid shākya shrī la 'dud// bstan rtsa bag yod khrims kyis legs bsdams pa'i// jo gdan 'dus pa rgya mtshos gus bsnyen pa'i// byang rdor gnyis sogs tshogs chen sde bzhi yi// 'dul 'dzin mkhan slob rim byon rnams la'ang 'dud// 'phags yul nā lend+ra sogs sde chen dang*// gangs can sngon byung dpal ldan tshogs chen bzhi'i// ngo mtshar ltad mo deng 'dir slar 'char ba'i// bsam don yid bzhin 'grub par byin gyis rlobs// zhes pa 'di ni dge sbyong wā gind+ras sdom gsum dang gzhi gsum cho ga sogs 'khos ka la ma ran pa'i rtsom chos chen po bgyis skabs re smon 'grub pa'i ched du gsol ba'o/ siddhi rastu// ༈ /yul dam pa rnams la gsol ba 'debs pa dad pa'i sa bon zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bhyaḥ spangs rtogs mthar phyin zhi ba chos kyi dbyings// mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar bde chen longs spyod rdzogs// gdul bya'i khams dang mthun par sprul pa'i gar// sku gsum rnam 'dren rgya mtshor gsol ba 'debs// bskal bzang sgron me bzhi pa shākya'i tog /ma pham 'jam pa'i dbyangs dang gsang ba'i bdag /spyan ras gzigs dbang mtsho skyes rdo rje sogs// rgyal dang de sras rnams la= /gnas brtan bcu drug gtad rabs rnam pa bdun// rgyan drug slob dpon gsum dang rig 'dzin brgyad// rnal 'byor dbang phyug brgyad cu rtsa bzhi sogs// 'phags yul paṇa grub rnams la= /gangs can bstan pa'i srol 'byed rnying ma ba// yongs rdzogs bstan pa rgyas mdzad sa skya pa// bstan 'dzin bye ba'i 'byung gnas bka' gdams pa'i// bshes gnyen brgyud par bcas la= /zla med grub pa'i gseng lam bka' brgyud pa// zab rgyas rgyud sde'i mnga' bdag bu dol gnyis// 'jam dbyangs chos kyi nyi ma tsong kha pa// brgyud 'dzin slob mar bcas la=
