/ltung ba'i rnam gzhag sgro 'dogs legs chod nas// smon 'jug so so'i mi mthun phyogs spong zhing*// rtsa ltung dang ni pham 'dra nyes byas kyis// ma gos rang rgyud rnam par dag par shog /khyad chos bzhi ldan pha rol phyin drug gi// rang bzhin tshogs chen gnyis kyis rang smin cing*// bsdu dngos bzhi yi thabs kyis gzhan smin byed// theg chen sgrub pa'i rim pa mthar phyin shog /sems can smin dang zhing khams dag par sbyong*// byang chub chos kun rdzogs te mi gnas pa'i// myang 'das phrin las 'khor ba ma stong bar// rgyun mi chad par smon bzhin 'grub gyur cig /zab mo lta ba'i srol 'byed klu sgrub zhabs// rgya chen spyod tshul gsal mdzad thogs med rje'i// dgongs pa zung du 'brel ba'i bkra shis kyis// 'gro kun gol ba'i lam las srung gyur cig /dam pa'i don du ngo bo nyid med ston// kun rdzob sgrub pa phyin ci ma log pa'i// rgyal sras lam bzang nyin mor byed pa'i gzis// chos ltar bcos pa'i mun pa mthar byed shog /ces byang sems sdom rgyun gsol 'debs lhag bsam mandā ra'i chun po zhes bya ba 'di nyid dbu sems kyi sems bskyed srol gnyis kyi rtsa ba'i brgyud pa re bzung ste dge sbyong wā gind+ras bris pa yin la brgyud pa'i rnam grangs gzhan yang yod do// ༈ /spyod 'jug gi brgyud 'debs ni/ na mo ratna trā yā ya/ chos kyi rgyal po thub dbang nyi ma'i gnyen// sa bcu'i dbang phyug rje btsun 'jam pa'i dbyangs// rab dga'i sa brnyes rgyal sras zhi ba lha// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mi brjed gzungs thob paṇa chen lnga brgya'i tshogs// bdud dpung dgra las rnam rgyal dzai tā ri// sems dpa' chen po tsand+ra kīrti'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// rgya chen lung gi mdzod 'dzin puṇya shrī// byang chub spyod pa mthar phyin ka na shrī// thugs rje'i dbang phyug legs pa'i blo gros zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so=

/rgyal bas lung bstan blo ldan shes rab zhabs// thos bsam sgom pas rgyud phyug gro lung pa// rig pa'i dbang phyug phya pa chen po'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /mtha' yas mkhyen pa'i dpal mnga' bsod nams rtse// rtogs pa'i dbang phyug rje btsun rin po che// shes bya kun rigs sa skya paṇḍi ta/ gsol ba= /sdom brtson 'dul ba 'dzin pa byang chub dpal// mang thos sgrub la cher brtson bde ba dpal// sde snod kun mkhyen grags pa gzhon nu'i zhabs// gsol ba= /gnas brtan mkhas pa'i dbang po bsod nams skyabs// skye dgu'i gtsug rgyan bsod nams rgyal mtshan dpal// gdams pa'i dbang phyug dpal ldan tshul khrims zhabs// gsol ba= /ye shes lnga ldan bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan 'dzin// byams dang snying rje'i dpal 'byor bzang po can// thams cad mkhyen pa shar chen rin po cher// gsol ba= /khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po e waṃ pa// gang de'i chos kyi rgyal tshab mus pa che// dpal ldan phyogs las rnam rgyal go rams par// gsol ba= /dri med bstan pa rgyas mdzad dkon mchog 'phel// ye shes mchog brnyes lha mchog seng ge'i zhabs// gzhung lugs rgya mtsho'i mdzod 'dzin shar khang par// gsol ba= /mkhas pa'i rigs 'khrungs nam mkha' dpal bzang po// mkhas dang grub pa gnyis ldan sgrub khang pa// bsam yas yon tan gter chen bka' 'gyur bar// gsol ba= /rab 'byams mtshan can rin chen rgya mtsho dang*// gtsug lag smra ba'i dbang po dol paṇa zhabs// snyigs dus bstan pa'i snang byed rmor chen rjer// gsol ba= /bla ma'i thugs zin sangs rgyas bkra shis zhabs// mthu stobs grub pa'i rigs 'khrungs gnas gsar ba// 'jam dbyangs gzugs gzhan zlos pa'i 'khon ston cher// gsol ba= /lung rtogs bstan 'dzin bsod nams dpal bzang po// khrims ldan 'dus pa'i gtso bo kun dga' dpal// bshes gnyen dam pa blo gros rgya mtsho la// gsol ba=

/'jam dpal gzhon nu rdo rje rin chen dang*// dam pa mang po'i gsung gi mdzod bzung nas// 'chad pa'i srol chen 'dzugs mkhas drin chen rjer// gsol ba 'debs so byin gyis brlab tu gsol// mi khom brgyad spangs 'byor pa bcu ldan pa'i// lus rten phun tshogs dal ba thob dus 'dir// sdig spangs dge ba 'bad pas bsten dgos zhes// bsam gtan dge blo skye bar byin gyis rlobs// theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba sems bskyed kyi// bsam yas phan yon rnam mang rjes dran pas// smon dang 'jug pa'i rin chen sems bskyed mchog /rnam dag cho gas len par byin gyis rlobs// rin chen sems de rab tu gzung bya'i phyir// rgyal ba'i sras kyi lam mchog tshul khrims gsum// rnam mang mdo sde'i tshogs las gang gsungs rnams// tshul bzhin srung sdom byed par byin gyis rlobs// sbyin dang tshul khrims bzod dang brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab pha rol phyin sogs kyi// rang la sangs rgyas chos rnams yongs rdzogs nas// rgyal sras spyod la gnas par byin gyis rlobs// byang chub lam la sbyangs pa'i dge rtsa kun// rmad byung smon lam bzang pos mtshams sbyar nas// sku gsum mthar phyin rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi// go 'phang myur du thob par byin gyis rlobs// byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la 'jug pa'i bla ma brgyud pa la gsol ba 'debs pa'i rim pa shākya'i dge slong kun dga' bzang pos sbyar ba'o// 'di la lung gi brgyud pas kha skong shlo ka bdun wā gind+ras bris pa'o// ༈ /swa sti/ mkha' khyab byis dang 'phags tshogs ma lus pa// re re'ang ro 'dzin grangs med ldan gyur te// srid mthar rtag tu brjod kyang mi zad pa'i// yon tan gter chen thub dbang la phyag 'tshal// mgon po'i dus gsum mdzad pa phun tshogs ltar// bdag gi tshe rabs kun gyi spyod pa rnams// rang don yid byed dug dang ma 'dres par// gzhan phan bdud rtsi kho nas 'tsho bar shog

/gang gis bdag mthong thos dran reg brjod dang*// phan gnod btang snyoms las byed la sogs pa'i// 'gro kun sgrib gnyis byang zhing tshogs rdzogs nas// bla med byang chub chen po myur thob shog /ces pa 'di'ang btsun pa dpal ldan don grub kyis snga dro ldang ba'i dus thams cad du ston pa mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la phyag 'tshal ba'i dam bca' mi brjed par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ de'i rnam thar la slob tshul mdor bsdus smon lam du byas te e waṃ chos 'khor rtser bris pa'o// sangs rgyas gtso la phyag 'tshal lo// skyob pa'i chos la phyag 'tshal lo// dge 'dun che la phyag 'tshal lo// gsum la rtag tu mgos phyag 'tshal// sangs rgyas yon tan bsam mi khyab// dam pa'i chos kyang bsam mi khyab// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun bsam mi khyab// bsam mi khyab la dad byas pa'i// rnam par smin pa'ang bsam mi khyab// rnam dag zhing du skye bar shog/ ༈ /so thar sdom rgyun gsol 'debs dad gsum karṇi ka'i chun po zhes bya ba bzhugs so// thub pa'i dbang po shes rab can gyi mchog /sgra gcan 'dzin dang bram ze sgra gcan 'dzin// 'phags pa klu sgrub gu ṇa mi tra dang*// rin chen bshes gnyen chos kyi bzang po'i zhabs// gu ṇa pa ti chos kyi phreng ba dang*// 'byung gnas sbas pa paṇa chen shākya shrī// rdo rje dpal dang mkhan chen 'od zer dpal// bsod nams dpal dang bkra shis tshul khrims dang*// gnas brtan chen po ye shes rgyal mtshan zhabs// kun mkhyen kun bzang dpal ldan rdo rje dang*// dkon mchog 'phel dang rgyal ba lha yi mtshan// sangs rgyas seng ge nam mkha' dpal bzang dang*// bsod nams lhun grub shes rab 'byung gnas zhabs// ye shes bzang po tshul khrims dpal bzang po// bsod nams bzang po nam mkha' bsam 'grub dang*// sangs rgyas grags pa ngag dbang dam chos mtshan// dpal ldan lung rtogs chos kyi rgyal mtshan te// mkhan brgyud rim byon rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bsam pa sems bskyed cho ga rnam dag las// skyes pa'i nges 'byung tshul khrims bdud rtsi yis// bdag rgyud bran pa'i bsil ba thob pa'i mod// 'phags pa dgyes pa'i rnam thar 'dzin gyur cig

/thub pa'i dbang pos tshul khrims ldan pa nyid// sangs rgyas 'byung 'phrad rgyan rnams kun gyi mchog /dri dang byug pa dga' ba kun gyi gnas// gdung ba bsil chu 'jig rten kun gyis bstod// 'gro ba dam pa mnos shing sbrul gdug pas// 'tshe bar mi nus 'od dang grags bde thob/ mig dang rgyu byed bum pa bzang po'i dpes// bsngags pa'i yon tan chos kun rdzogs gyur cig /ldog pa'i tshul khrims sgo gsum nyes spyod bral// 'jug pa'i tshul khrims nyan sems sgom pa yis// zhi lhag rgyu 'bras tshul bskyed lam lnga pa// rnam grol zad mi skye shes mngon gyur cig /lus la chos gos gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ngag la sde snod gsum gyi bkra shis shog /sems la bslab pa gsum gyi bkra shis shog /kun la dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /srid gsum ston pa mtshungs med shākya'i rgyal// sbyangs pa'i yon tan gyis 'phags 'od srungs te// 'dul ba 'dzin gtso u pa li la sogs// 'phags tshogs bkra shis snang ba 'bar gyur cig /bstan pa'i rtsa ba legs gsungs 'dul ba'i chos// bshad dang lag len gtan la phab pa'i dbyangs// yang srid lnga pa las byung dge mtshan ni// srid gsum gdul bya'i rna bar snyan gyur cig /ces pa 'di ni dge sbyong gi rtags tsam 'chang ba wā gind+ras sbyar ba'o// 'di ni rang nyid kyis nos pa'i sdom rgyun te gzhan dag gis rang rang gi sdom rgyun la bsgyur shes par bya'o// sarba maṅga laṃ bhū yā ta// ༈ /blo sbyong don bdun ma'i brgyud 'debs ni/ tshogs gnyis rab rdzogs 'dren mchog shākya'i tog /rgyal ba'i rgyal tshab rgyal sras mi pham mgon// sa gsum mnga' bdag 'phags pa thogs med zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// kun mkhyen gnyis pa rgyal sras dbyig gi gnyen// mtha' bral don gzigs 'phags pa rnam grol sde// bden gnyis don rtog btsun pa rnam grol sde// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// 'gro ba'i rtsa lag gu ṇa mi tra'i zhabs// lta ngan ri dwags 'joms mdzad seng ge bzang*// bdag gzhan tshogs gnyis spel mdzad gang ba spel// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// yon tan rin chen gter gyur ku sā li// bdag gzhan brje mdzad ku sā li gnyis pa// mkhas grub chen po mnyam med gser gling pa// gsol ba 'debs so=

/yid bzhin nor 'dra'i thugs mnga' mar me mdzad// rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ston pa rin po che// bstan pa rin chen gsal mdzad pu to ba// gsol ba 'debs so= /yon tan mchog gis grags pa'i sha ra ba// byang chub thugs gnyis 'byongs pa'i 'chad ka ba// lta spyod rnam par dag pa'i rgyal ba se// gsol ba 'debs so= /gcig tu gzhan don mdzad pa'i skyes mchog lha// bslab gsum rnam par dag pa'i lha sdings pa// sgo gsum gzhan don mdzad pa'i lha sdings dbon// gsol ba 'debs so= /dus gsum rgyal ba'i lam gnas yon tan dpal// sangs rgyas bstan pa rgyas mdzad bde ba dpal// mkhas btsun 'gran zla bral ba'i ka bzhi pa// gsol ba 'debs so= /phan bde kun gyi 'byung gnas rin po che// bsod nams ye shes stobs kyis stong gsum grags// byams dang snying rje'i mnga' bdag chos kyi rje// gsol ba 'debs so= /kha skong ni/ dus gsum rgyal ba'i sras mchog bzang po dpal// rtse gcig sgrub la brtson mdzad buddha shrī// byang phyogs thub pa'i rgyal tshab e waṃ pa// gsol ba 'debs so= /phyag na padmo'i rnam 'phrul mus chen rje// rgya chen shes bya kun gzigs gung ru ba// ngag gi dbang phyug gnyug la paṇa chen zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /spyan snga sems dpa' chen po chos grags mtshan// chos kyi spyan ldan she 'u lo tsā ba// srid zhi'i phun tshogs rab rgyas bco brgyad par// gsol ba 'debs so= /zab rgyas gdams pa'i mdzod 'dzin mkhyen rab zhabs// mdo sngags bstan pa'i sgron me rmor chen rje// mkhyen brtse nus pa'i bdag nyid gnas gsar pa// gsol ba 'debs so= /snyigs dus 'gro ba'i skyabs mgon sa skya pa// rig pa'i dbang phyug kun dga' mkhas grub dbang*// bka' drin mnyam med rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so= /yang na/ spyan snga sems dpa' chen po chos grags mtshan// ces pa'i mtshams/

mdo rgyud mnga' bdag gzhon nu chos dpal bzang*// 'jam dbyangs 'khon ston dpal 'byor lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so= /mkhas grub dpal 'byor phrin las rab rgyas dang*// phyag na padmo blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde// lung rtogs gter chen blo bzang dar rgyas zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= /gnas brtan chen po 'jam dbyangs grags pa'i dpal// lam bzang gsal mdzad dge legs rgya mtsho'i zhabs// ngag gi dbang phyug byams mgon gnyis pa la// gsol ba 'debs so= /rig grol mthar phyin ye shes rgyal mtshan dpal// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos bstan pa'i sgron me che// skyabs gnas kun 'dus rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs// zhes so// rnyed dka' yon tan ldan pa'i dal 'byor 'di// don med tshe 'di'i bya bas mi g.yeng bar// drag la rgyun mi chad pa'i brtson 'grus kyis// nyin mtshan chos kyis 'da' bar byin gyis rlobs// chu bur lta bur mi rtag lus srog 'di// nam 'jig nges pa med par rtogs gyur nas// tshe 'di'i phun tshogs sgrub pa'i bsam sbyor rnams// skad cig tsam yang med par byin gyis rlobs// srid pa'i bde la nam yang ma zhen cing*// rang nyid zhi ba don du mi gnyer bar// 'gro kun don du sangs rgyas sgrub pa yi// bsam sbyor rgyun mi chad par byin gyis rlobs// thog med dus nas gnyen gyur 'gro ba rnams// sdug bsngal rgya mtshor bying ba mthong gyur nas// bu sdug chu yis khyer ba'i ma bzhin du// bcos min snying rje skye bar byin gyis rlobs// rang bde 'dod las nyes pa kun 'byung zhing*// gzhan phan sems las yon tan kun 'byung phyir// gzhan skyon bdag la len cing bdag nyid kyi// bde dge gzhan la gtong bar byin= /rang nyid gces par 'dzin pa'i dgra bo 'dis// thog med dus nas rang gzhan sdug bsngal byas// phyin chad byang chub sems gnyis stobs rgyas nas// bdag 'dzin rtsad nas thon par byin=

/'gro 'dis thog med dus nas phan btags shing*// byang chub sgrub pa'ang 'di la rag las pas// rgyal ba bzhin du phan bde'i rgyur mthong nas// gus pas spyi bor len par byin= /las ngan dbang gis snod bcud 'gal rkyen gyis// gang ba'i dus 'dir 'gal rkyen kun spangs nas// logs nas dam chos sgrub dbang mi gda' bas// rkyen ngan lam du slong bar byin= /bde sdug phan gnod 'byor rgud ci byung yang*// rmi lam yul gyi 'byor rgud ji bzhin du// snang yang bden pa med par shes byas nas// zhen med rang sar grol bar byin gyis rlobs// zhes rgyal sras thogs med bzang po dpal gyi gsung rje bla ma'i zhal skong dang bcas pa'o// ༈ /byang chub lam rim gyi brgyud 'debs la/ thog mar rgya chen spyod brgyud kyi gsol 'debs ni/ 'dren pa mnyam med ston pa bcom ldan 'das// rgyal tshab dam pa rje btsun mi pham mgon// rgyal bas lung bstan 'phags pa thogs med zhabs// sangs rgyas byang sems gsum la gsol ba 'debs// 'dzam gling mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan dbyig gi gnyen// dbu ma'i lam brnyes 'phags pa rnam grol sde// dad pa'i sar gnas btsun pa rnam grol sde// 'jig rten mig 'byed gsum la= /rmad byung ngo mtshar gnas gyur mchog gi sde// zab mo'i lam gyis rgyud sbyangs dul ba'i sde// rlabs chen spyod pa'i gter gyur rnam snang mdzad// 'gro ba'i rtsa lag gsum la= /lam mchog sher phyin rgyas mdzad seng bzang zhabs// rgyal ba'i man ngag kun 'dzin ku sā li// 'gro kun brtse bas rjes 'dzin dge ba can// 'gro ba'i ded dpon gsum la= /byang chub thugs la mnga' brnyes gser gling pa// shing rta chen po'i srol 'dzin mar me mdzad// lam bzang gsal mdzad ston pa rin po che// bstan pa'i srog shing gsum la= /rnal 'byor dbang phyug dpal ldan dgon pa ba// zab mo'i ting 'dzin brtan pa'i sne zur pa// 'dul ba'i sde snod kun 'dzin thag ma ba// mtha' 'khob sgron me gsum la=

/brtson pas sgrub pa lhur len nam seng zhabs// dam pas byin brlabs nam mkha' rgyal po dang*// 'jig rten chos brgyad spangs pa'i seng ge bzang*// rgyal sras bzang po'i zhabs la= /byang chub thugs rjes 'gro kun bu bzhin gzigs// lhag pa'i lha yis rjes bzung byin gyis brlabs// snyigs dus 'gro ba 'dren pa'i bshes gnyen mchog /nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la= /dmigs med brtse ba'i gter chen spyan ras gzigs// dri med mkhyen pa'i dbang po 'jam pa'i dbyangs// gangs can mkhas pa'i gtsug rgyan tsong kha pa// blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la= /mkhas grub chen po shes rab seng ge'i zhabs// thams cad mkhyen dngos dge 'dun grub pa dang*// sku gsum go 'phang mngon gyur nor bu bzang*// dpal ldan bla ma gsum la= /dbyangs can bzhad pa dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i sde// smra ba'i nyi ma dge legs dpal bzang po// mkhas grub lha btsun bsod nams dpal bzang ste// bshes gnyen dam pa gsum la= /phyag na padma bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhabs// zab don gdams pa'i bka' babs chos dpal bzang*// rigs kun bdag po dpal 'byor lhun grub zhabs// mkhas grub chen po gsum la= /bka' drin mnyam med shrī bhū ti'i mtshan// ngag gi dbang dbang phyug blo bzang rgya mtsho'i sde// 'jam dpal dbyangs dngos ngag dbang dpal bzang po// rnam 'dren dam pa gsum la= /bshes gnyen dam pa byams pa chos ldan dang*// rtsa ba'i bla ma dge legs rgya mtsho'i sde// bstan pa'i srog shing ngag dbang byams pa'i dpal// snyigs dus 'gro 'dren gsum la= /mkhas btsun grub brnyes byams pa smon lam dang*// ye shes mchog gzigs bstan pa rab rgyas zhabs// smra ba'i dbang phyug ngag dbang chos 'phel te// lung rtog mdzod 'dzin gsum la= /byams pa'i dpal mnga' dmigs med thugs rje'i gter// mkhyen pas chos kun de nyid rab tu gzigs// phun tshogs sku bzhi'i bdag nyid bla ma lhas// rjes bzung bshes gnyen dam par gsol ba 'debs// rab 'byams gsung rab kun la lta ba'i mig

/bskal bzang thar par bgrod pa'i 'jug ngogs mchog /brtse bas bskyod pa'i thabs mkhas mdzad pa yis// gsal mdzad bshes gnyen rnams la gsol ba 'debs// zhes dang*/ zab mo lta ba'i brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs ni/ smra ba zla med 'dren mchog shākya'i tog /rgyal ba'i mkhyen rab kun bsdus 'jam pa'i dbyangs// zab mo'i don gzigs 'phags mchog klu sgrub zhabs// smra ba'i gtsug rgyan gsum la= /'phags pa'i dgongs pa gsal mdzad zla ba grags// de sras thu bo rig pa'i khu byug che// rgyal sras rig pa'i khu byug gnyis pa'i zhabs// rig pa'i dbang phyug gsum la= /rten 'brel zab mo ji bzhin gzigs pa yi// shing rta chen po'i srol 'dzin mar me mdzad// lam bzang gsal mdzad ston pa rin po che// 'dzam gling rgyan gyur gnyis la= /rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob bshes gnyen pu to ba// rnam dpyod 'gran zla bral ba'i sha ra ba// byang chub thugs kyi bka' babs 'chad ka ba// 'gro ba'i re skong gsum la= /lung rtogs mnga' bdag byang sems spyil bu ba// dri med lung gi dbang phyug mkhas pa'i gtso// khams gsum 'gro ba'i mgon po rin po che// gnas brtan chen po gsum la= /rnam dag tshul khrims ngad ldangs zangs chen pa// 'dul ba 'bum sde'i mnga' bdag mtsho sna ba// chos mngon rgya mtsho'i mthar son mon gra pa// 'gro ba'i 'dren pa gsum la= /zab cing rgya che'i chos la mnga' brnyes pas// skal ldan 'gro ba kun gyi skyabs su gyur// phrin las bzang pos bstan pa rgyas mdzad pa// rje btsun bla ma'i zhabs la= /blo gros khang bzang bslab gsum nor gyis phyug /bzang po'i phrin las gdul bya'i dpal du shar// grags pa'i 'od zer 'dzam gling phyogs bcur 'phro// blo bzang grags pa'i zhabs la= /mkhas grub chen po shes rab seng ge'i zhabs// zhes sogs man gong ltar ro// yang na ston pa rin po che'i rjes su/ grub pa'i dbang phyug chen po tshul khrims 'bar// bshes gnyen tshul bzhin bsten mdzad gzhon nu 'od// theg mchog lam gyis rgyud sbyangs sgyer sgom zhabs// rgyal ba'i sras po gsum la=

/rmad byung yon tan mdzod 'dzin sangs rgyas dbon// dam pas byin brlabs nam mkha' rgyal po dang*// nas/ nam mkha' rgyal mtshan zhabs la= /blo gros khang bzang sogs gong bzhin no// ༈ /de lta bu'i lam gyi rim pa'i mngon rtogs rgyud la skye ba'i gsol 'debs ni/ yon tan kun gyi gzhir gyur drin can rje// tshul bzhin bsten pa lam gyi rtsa ba ru// legs par mthong nas 'bad pa du ma yis// gus pa chen pos bsten par byin gyis rlobs// lan cig rnyed pa'i dal ba'i rten bzang 'di// shin tu rnyed dka' don che shes gyur nas// nyin mtshan kun tu snying po len pa'i blo// rgyun chad med par skye bar byin= /lus srog g.yo ba chu yi chu bur bzhin// myur du 'jig pa'i 'chi ba dran pa dang*// shi ba'i rjes su lus dang grib ma bzhin// dkar nag las 'bras phyi bzhin 'brang ba la// nges pa brtan po rnyed nas nyes pa'i tshogs// phra zhing phra ba rnams kyang spong ba dang*// dge tshogs mtha' dag sgrub par byed pa la// rtag tu bag dang ldan par byin gyis rlobs// spyad pas mi ngoms sdug bsngal kun gyi sgo// yid brtan mi rung srid pa'i phun tshogs kyi// nyes dmigs rig nas thar pa'i bde ba la// don gnyer chen po skye bar byin gyis rlobs// rnam dag bsam pa de yis drangs pa yi// dran dang shes bzhin bag yod brtan po yis// bstan pa'i rtsa ba so sor thar pa la// sgrub pa snying por byed par byin gyis rlobs// rang nyid srid mtshor lhung ba ji bzhin du// mar gyur 'gro ba kun kyang de 'dra bar// mthong nas 'gro ba sgrol ba'i khur 'khyer ba'i// byang chub sems mchog 'byongs par byin gyis rlobs// sems tsam bskyed kyang tshul khrims rnam gsum la// goms pa med na byang chub mi 'grub par// legs par mthong nas rgyal sras sdom pa la// brtson pa drag pos slob par byin gyis rlobs// log pa'i yul la g.yeng ba zhi byed cing*// yang dag don la tshul bzhin dpyad pa yis// zhi gnas lhag mthong zung du 'brel ba'i lam// myur du rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// thun mong lam sbyangs snod du gyur pa na// theg pa kun gyi mchog gyur rdo rje'i theg

/skal bzang skye bo'i 'jug ngogs dam pa der// bde blag nyid du 'jug par byin gyis rlobs// de tshe dngos grub rnam gnyis 'grub pa'i gzhi// rnam dag dam tshig sdom par gsungs pa la// bcos ma min pa'i nges pa rnyed gyur nas// srog dang bsdos te srung bar byin gyis rlobs// de nas rgyud sde'i snying po rim gnyis kyi// gnad rnams ji bzhin rtogs nas brtson pa yis// thun bzhi'i rnal 'byor spyod las mi g.yel bar// dam pa'i gsung bzhin sgrub par byin gyis rlobs// de ltar lam bzang ston pa'i bshes gnyen dang*// tshul bzhin sgrub pa'i grogs rnams zhabs brtan cing*// phyi dang nang gi bar du gcod pa'i tshogs// nye bar zhi bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol// skye ba kun tu yang dag bla ma dang*// 'bral med chos kyi dpal la longs spyod cing*// sa dang lam gyi yon tan rab rdzogs nas// rdo rje 'chang gi go 'phang myur thob shog /ces pa'ang rje btsun bla ma nyid kyis gsan pa ltar brgyud pa'i kha skong gnang ba dang bcas pa'o// ༈ /rgyud gsum bla ma brgyud pa'i gsol 'debs/ na maḥshrī tsakra nā tha ratna wardhārṣa ya/ kun khyab 'khor lo'i dbang phyug bde ba che// zag med rnam thar gsum gyi ngo bo nyid// ngo mtshar sgyu ma'i gar gyis rnam rol ba'i// kun bzang rdo rje 'chang chen la gsol ba 'debs// de dang gnyis su med pa'i shes rab yum// sprul pa'i gar mdzad bdag med mkha' 'gro dang*// rgyal rigs rig gnas kun mkhyen sa drug brnyes// mthu stobs rnal 'byor dbang phyug la gsol ba 'debs// mu stegs rigs las grub pa'i sa brnyes pa'i// 'chi med dbang po kahṇa'i mtshan can dang*// dbus 'gyur tshal 'khrungs rten 'brel don gzigs pa'i// rje btsun ḍa ma ru pa la= /wā rā ṇa sīr gzhon nu'i sar bzhugs te// gnyis med gzigs pa a ba dhū tī dang*// rig gnas kun sbyang 'pho bas mkha' la gshegs// paṇa chen ga ya dha ra la=

/mthu stobs mgon pos rjes bzung ḍombi pa// ngo mtshar rdo rje nags khrod garbha rī// dza ya shrī mi thub zla ba dang*// shes rab dbang po mdzes pa la= /skad gnyis smra ba shākya ye shes dang*// de sras snying po rig snang rgyal po'i mtha'// rig dang snying pos rjes bzung 'bar ba yi// mtha' can bla ma rnam gnyis la= /rmad byung brgyud pa kun gyi bka' babs shing*// khyad par mthu stobs mgon dang gnyis su med// ngo mtshar gtam mang mnga' ba'i sa skya pa// brtse chen kun dga' snying po la= /gang de'i sku gsung thugs kyi sras kyi mchog /'jam dbyangs sprul pa bsod nams rtse mo dang*// gsang chen bstan pa rgyas mdzad rdo rje 'chang*// rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan la= /rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes gcig bsdus pa// thub dbang gnyis pa sa skya paṇa chen dang*// 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag 'phags pa'i mchog /chos rgyal blo gros rgyal mtshan la= /'gro mgon bla mas rjes bzung dga' ldan pa// bkra shis dpal dang zhang ston dkon mchog dpal// de sras chos kyi spyan ldan brag phug pa// mtshungs med puṇya shrī la= /mtha' yas skye rgu'i skyabs gcig sems dpa' che// gnas lnga rig pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan dang*// 'jig rten bya ba kun spangs ri khrod pa// dpal ldan blo gros brtan pa la= /bla ma gnyis sogs mkhas grub du ma yi// bshad dang sgrub pa'i bka' babs dpal ldan pa// mkhas pa'i dbang po ye shes rgyal mtshan dang*// grub chen buddha shrī la= /mkhas grub bla ma gnyis kyis rjes su bzung*// snyigs dus bstan pa'i bdag por lung bstan brnyes// rdo rje 'chang zhes 'gro la rab grags pa'i// kun mkhyen kun dga' bzang po la= /nges don bstan pa'i srog shing mus pa che// sems dpa' chen po dkon mchog rgyal mtshan zhabs// de sras grub brnyes kun dga' dbang phyug dang*// mkhas mchog bsod nams seng ge la=

/zab yangs mkhyen pa'i gter chen 'jam pa'i dbyangs// tshad med thugs rje'i bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs// phul byung mdzad pa bsam yas rdo rje 'chang*// 'dren mchog ratna wardhā la= /dus gsum rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul chos kyi rje// bka' drin mnyam med sangs rgyas rin po che// rgya chen chos kyi spyan ldan sa skya pa// 'jam dbyangs kun dga' bsod nams la= /'di nas bla ma gsum kha skong*/ bla ma gsum gyi thugs las 'khrungs pa'i sras// rig gnas kun la spobs pa dge ba can// yongs rdzogs bstan pa'i mnga' bdag e waṃ pa// mtshungs med dkon mchog lhun grub la= /rig gnas mthar phyin buddha siṃ ha dang*// skyabs gnas mthar thug dkon mchog dpal ldan pa// mkhyen rab phul phyin shes rab rgyal mtshan dang*// paṇa chen nam mkha' dpal bzang la= /mchog gsum ngo bo bla mas rjes bzung nas// rigs gsum gdul bya'i tshogs rnams thams cad la// theg gsum chos kyi dga' ston 'gyed mkhas pa'i// shar chen kun dga' bkra shis la= /yang kha bskangs pa/ rtse gdong khri chen dpal ldan don grub zhabs// dpal mchog rgyal mtshan sangs rgyas phun tshogs dang*// tshul khrims dpal bzang bsod nams bzang po dang*// byams pa nam mkha' bsam 'grub la= /ngag dbang kun blo sangs rgyas grags pa dang*// nam mkha' 'chi med ngag dbang dam chos mtshan// 'khor lo'i mgon po kun dga' bstan 'dzin zhabs// 'jam dbyangs mkhyen brtse'i dbang po la gsol ba 'debs// zhes man ngag lugs kyi dbang mkhan chen rnam gnyis kyi gsan yul tha dad pa'i brgyud pa phyogs bsdus su bkod pa dang*/ brtse chen yab sras chos rje khu dbon zhabs// mdo sde dpal dang kun bsod nam mkha'i mtshan// dpal ldan seng ge bla ma dam pa'i zhabs// mkhan chen rgyal ba bzang po la gsol= /byang chub seng ge ye shes rgyal mtshan zhabs// ngor chen rdo rje 'chang dang rgyal tshab rje// dkon mchog 'phel dang sa skya lo tsā ba// 'jam dbyangs dkon mchog lhun grub la=

brgyud bla ma rnams la gsol ba 'debs// bskyed pa phyi dbyibs sogs sbrel/ bar 'dir bde gsang dus gsum sogs rgyud sde rnams kyi brgyud 'debs 'jug dgos kyang kye rdor gyi brgyud 'debs 'di tsam gyis sngags kyi phyogs mtshon par byas pa las gzhan dag brir ma long ngo*// bcu gnyis pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ me tog dam pa phreng ba dam pa dang*// sil snyan rnams dang byug pa gdugs mchog dang*// mar me mchog dang bdug spos dam pa yis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// na bza' dam pa rnams dang dri mchog dang*// phyi ma phur ma ri rab mnyam pa dang*// bkod pa khyad par 'phags pa mchog kun gyis// rgyal ba de dag la ni mchod par bgyi// mchod pa gang rnams bla med rgya che ba// de dag rgyal ba thams cad la yang mos// bzang po spyod la dad pa'i stobs dag gis// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal mchod par bgyi// rin chen sems de gzung bar bya ba'i phyir// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang dam pa'i chos// dkon mchog dri ma med dang sangs rgyas sras// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la legs par mchod// me tog 'bras bu ji snyed yod pa dang*// sman gyi rnam pa gang zhig yod pa dang*// 'jig rten rin chen ji snyed yod pa dang*// chu gtsang yid du 'ong ba ci yod dang*// rin chen ri bo dang ni de bzhin du// nags tshal sa phyogs dben zhing nyams dga' dang*// ljon shing me tog rgyan spras spud pa dang*// shing gang 'bras bzang yal ga dud pa dang*// lha sogs 'jig rten na yang dri dang ni// spos dang dpag bsam shing dang rin chen shing*// ma rmos 'khrungs pa'i lo tog rnam pa dang*// gzhan yang mchod par 'os pa'i rgyan rnams ni// mtsho dang rdzing bu padmas brgyan pa dag

/ngang pa shin tu skad snyan yid 'ong ldan// nam mkha' rab 'byams khams kyi mthas gtugs pa// yongs su gzung ba med pa de dag kun// blo yis blangs nas thub pa skyes kyi mchog /sras dang bcas pa rnams la legs 'bul na// yon gnas dam pa thugs rje che rnams kyis// bdag la brtser dgongs bdag gi 'di dag bzhes// bdag ni bsod nams mi ldan bkren chen te// mchod pa'i nor gzhan bdag la cang ma mchis// des na gzhan don dgongs pa'i mgon gyis 'di// bdag gi don slad nyid kyi mthus bzhes shig /rgyal dang de sras rnams la bdag gis ni// bdag gi lus kun gtan du dbul bar bgyi// sems dpa' mchog rnams bdag ni yongs bzhes shig /gus pas khyed kyi 'bangs su mchi bar bgyi// bdag ni khyed kyis yongs su bzung bas na// srid na mi 'jigs sems can phan par bgyi// sngon gyi sdig las yang dag 'da' bgyid cing*// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// khrus kyi khang pa shin tu dri zhim pa// shel gyi sa gzhi gsal zhing 'tsher bar bstar// rin chen 'bar ba'i ka ba yid 'ong ldan// mu tig 'od chags bla re bres pa der// de bzhin gshegs dang de yi sras rnams la// rin chen bum pa mang po spos kyi chus// yid 'ong legs par bkang ba glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol// de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bsgos pas sku phyi'o// de nas de la kha dog legs bsgyur ba'i// na bza' shin tu dri zhim dam pa 'bul// gos bzang srab la 'jam pa sna tshogs dang*// rgyan mchog brgya phrag de dang de dag gis// 'phags pa kun tu bzang dang 'jam dbyangs dang*// 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs la'ang rgyan par bgyi// stong gsum kun tu dri ngad ldang ba yi// dri mchog rnams kyis thub dbang kun gyi sku// gser sbyangs btso ma byi dor byas pa ltar// 'od chags 'bar ba de dag byug par bgyi// thub dbang mchod gnas mchog la yid 'ong ba'i// me tog mand+rā ra dang padma dang*// utpa la sogs dri zhim thams cad dang*// phreng ba spel legs yid 'ong rnams kyis mchod// spos mchog yid 'phrog dri ngad khyab pa yi// bdug pa'i sprin tshogs rnams kyang de la dbul// zhal zas bza' btung sna tshogs bcas pa yi// lha bshos rnams kyang de la dbul bar bgyi// gser gyi padma tshar du dngar ba yi// rin chen sgron me rnams kyang dbul bar bgyi// sa gzhi bstar ba spos kyis byugs pa der// me tog yid 'ong sil ma dgram par bya// gzhal med pho brang bstod dbyangs yid 'ong ldan// mu tig rin chen rgyan phreng mdzes 'bar ba// dpag yas nam mkha'i rgyan gyur de dag kyang*// thugs rje'i rang bzhin can la dbul bar bgyi// rin chen gdugs mdzes gser gyi yu ba can// khor yug rgyan gyi rnam pa yid 'ong ldan// dbyibs legs lta na sdug pa bsgrengs pa yang*// rtag tu thub dbang rnams la dbul bar bgyi// de las gzhan yang mchod pa'i tshogs// rol mo dbyangs snyan yid 'ong ldan// sems can sdug bsngal sim byed pa'i// sprin rnams so sor gnas gyur cig

/dam chos dkon mchog thams cad dang*// mchod rten rnams dang sku gzugs la// rin chen me tog la sogs char// rgyun mi chad par 'bab par shog /ji ltar 'jam dbyangs la sogs pas// rgyal ba rnams la mchod mdzad pa'i// de bzhin bdag gis de bzhin gshegs// mgon po sras dang bcas rnams mchod// yon tan rgya mtsho rnams la bdag /bstod dbyangs yan lag rgya mtshos bstod// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin de dag la// nges par kun tu 'byung gyur cig /oṃ badzra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi yongs su dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badzra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri khor yug gis bskor ba'i dbus su hūm̐/ ri'i rgyal po ri rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzambu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog 'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg pa ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ bdug pa ma/ me tog ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams dang*/ yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dam pa chos skyong ba'i srung ma gnod sbyin nor lha'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas bdag gi rgyud la bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ rim pa gnyis kyi ting nge 'dzin khyad par can rgyud la skye bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ sku gnyis kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes tshom bu so bdun ma dang*/ oṃ badzra bhū mi sogs nas/ sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ lha dang mi'i dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa 'di nyid bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la dbul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol/ bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes bdun ma dang*/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog /ces dang*/ zhing khams rnam par dag pa 'dir// dbus kyi ri rgyal ri rab la// gling bzhi 'dod yon lnga yis brgyan// nyi ma zla bas bskor ba byed// lha mi'i longs spyod phun sum tshogs// rgyal srid rin chen rnam pa bdun// 'dod 'jo'i ba dang dpag bsam shing*// ma rmos lo tog gser dang dngul// 'bru bzang longs spyod bsam mi khyab// dngos po bzang la gya nom pa// bla ma sangs rgyas rnams la 'bul// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par shog /oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwā maṇḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūm̐/ zhes bsdus pa rnams grangs ji ltar rigs pa'i mthar/ gang gi mchod rdzas zhing khams rgya mtshor rgya mtsho'i rdul snyed sna tshogs mchod pa'i sprin phung gis// rnam par brgyan pa'i rgyan gyi 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i 'od kyi rtse mor rgya mtsho yi// rdul gyi grangs snyed rin chen padmo rin chen 'od 'byin kun nas rgyas pa'i snying po la// lha dang mi yi 'dod yon rmad 'di 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byung bye ba phrag brgyar legs gnas pa// kun tu bzang po'i rnam 'phrul ji bzhin kun nas dge ba'i sems kyis sprul pa'i mchod sprin 'di// chos dbyings ji bzhin nam mkha'i khams kun kun la khyab cing sems can dbyings mtha' ji srid bar// rnam par gnas nas chos kyi rgyal po rgyal ba rgyal sras rang rgyal dgra las rnam rgyal bas// kun nas bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor kun tu rnam par mchod pa'i mchod pa kun gyis mnyes gyur cig

/deng nas byang chub snying po'i bar// bdag gi lus dang longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba'i dngos po rnams// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// gus pas khyed la dbul bar bgyi// kun nas gzigs pa'i spyan ldan pa// yon gnas dam pa khyed rnams kyis// bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs te// bdag gi 'di dag bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// oṃ gu ru buddha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra ratna maṇḍa la pū dza me gha sa mu dra spha ra na sa ma ye hūm̐/ bcu gsum pa sdig pa bshags pa ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dbang gis ni// lus dang ngag dang de bzhin yid yis kyis kyang*// sdig pa bdag gis bgyis pa ci mchis pa// de dag thams cad bdag gis so sor bshags// ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ gā thā dwa ya dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas dang ni chos la brnyas pa dang*// le lo dang ni cung tsam chog par 'dzin// 'dod chags dang ni nga rgyal spyod pa dang*// 'gyod pa dang ni ma nges 'byed pa rnams// sems can rnams kyi sgrib par 'gyur ba ste// de yi gnyen por theg pa mchog bstan pa// 'di yis bar du gcod pa de dag gis// nyes pa thams cad rab tu spong bar 'gyur/ tadya thā/ oṃ badzra prā kā ra badzra prā kā ra badzra tsakra deṣṭa bha yā na ke a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ tsa le tsu le/ tsu lu ke tsu lu ke tsu lu tsu lu sarba buddhe swā hā/ tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs la ni/ tshig gam don gyi sgo nas gang sbyor ba// sems can dam pa blo dang ldan pa des// phan yon rnam pa bcu dag 'thob par gyur// khams rnams mtha' dag rgyas par 'gyur ba dang*// 'chi ba'i tshe na mchog dga' dam pa thob// ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du skye ba dang*// thams cad du ni tshe rabs dran par 'gyur// sangs rgyas rnams dang phrad par 'gyur ba dang*// de bzhin de dag las ni theg mchog thos// mos par 'gyur ba blo dang bcas pa dang*// sgo gnyis dang ni byang chub myur du 'thob// tshigs su bcad pa gnyis pa'i gzungs rdzogs so//

༈ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa turgā thā/ bod skad du/ tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// skur gyur pa ni thams cad la'ang*// mtshan mchog sum cu gnyis mnga' ba'i// rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags ldan pa// rgyal ba kun la phyag 'tshal lo// rdzogs sangs gang du bltams pa dang*// gang du byang chub la reg dang*// zhi ba'i 'khor lo bskor ba dang*// zag med mya ngan 'das pa dang*// bde gshegs gang du bzhugs pa dang*// 'chag pa dang ni bzhengs pa dang*// seng ge lta bur gzims pa yi// gnas de la ni bdag phyag 'tshal// steng dang 'og dang bar dag dang*// phyogs dang phyogs mtshams rnams su yang*// skur bcas sku ni med pa yi// mchod rten la ni bdag phyag 'tshal// rkang gnyis dam pa shar dang ni// byang gi phyogs char bzhugs pa yi// rgyal ba bsten dka' zhes bya ba// des ni tshigs bcad 'di gsungs so// gang gis tshigs bcad 'di bzhi yis// de bzhin gshegs pa bstod byed na// bskal pa bye ba stong du ni// de ni ngan 'gror 'gro mi 'gyur// tshigs su bcad pa bzhi pa rdzogs so// ༈ /gzhan yang phung po gsum pa'i mdo 'don par spro na'ang skabs 'dir 'don cing*/ sangs rgyas rkang gnyis dam pa dag /thugs brtse thugs rje ldan pa'i thugs// gang dag phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na// bzhugs pa bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag gis sngon chad sdig pa'i las// shin tu mi bzad gang bgyis pa// stobs bcu'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// pha ma dag tu mi 'dzin dang*// sangs rgyas rnams su mi 'dzin dang*// dge ba dag tu mi 'dzin pas// sdig pa bdag gis gang bgyis dang*// phyug pa'i rgyags pas dregs pa dang*// rigs dang longs spyod rgyags pa dang*// gzhon pa'i rgyags pas dregs pa yis// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// nyes pa'i dmigs su ma mthong bas// nyes par bgyis pa'i las dang ni// nyes par bsam shing nyes smras pa'i// sdig las bdag gis gang bgyis dang*// byis pa'i blo yis 'jug pa dang*// mi shes mun pa'i sems dang ni// sdig pa'i grogs po'i dbang gyur dang*// nyon mongs rnam par 'khrugs sems dang*// rtsed mo dga' ba'i dbang nyid dang*// mya ngan dang ni nad dbang dang*// nor gyi sa mchog nyes pa yis// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// 'phags min skye bo 'dre ba dang*// phrag dog ser sna'i rgyu dang ni// g.yo dang dbul ba'i nyes pa yis// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// phongs dang rgud pa'i dus kyi tshe// 'dod pa rnams kyi 'jig rgyu dang*// phyug po ma yin gyur pa yis// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// g.yo ba'i sems kyi dbang nyid dang*// 'dod dang khro ba'i dbang dag dang*// bkres dang skom pas nyen pa yis// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// bza' ba dag dang btung ba dang*// bud med sgyu dang gos kyi phyir// nyon mongs gdung ba sna tshogs kyis// bdag gis sdig pa gang bgyis dang*// lus dang ngag dang yid kyi sdig

/nyes spyad rnam pa gsum bsags ni// 'di 'dra'i tshul gyis gang bgyis pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// sangs rgyas rnams dang chos rnams dang*// de bzhin nyan thos rnams la yang*// gus pa ma lags gang bgyis pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// gang yang rang sangs rgyas rnams dang*// byang chub sems dpa' rnams la yang*// gus pa ma lags bgyis pa rnams// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// dam chos smra ba rnams la yang*// gus pa ma lags bgyis pa dang*// chos la'ang gus par ma bgyis pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// bdag gis rtag tu mi shes pas// dam pa'i chos ni spangs pa dang*// pha ma rnams la ma gus gang*// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// blun po dang ni byis pa dang*// 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang*// nga rgyal dregs pas bsgribs bgyis pa// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// bdag gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten du// stobs bcu rnams la mchod par bgyi// bdag gis phyogs bcu'i sems can rnams// sdug bsngal kun las gdon par bgyi// sems can bsam gyis mi khyab kun// sa bcu la ni dgod par bgyi// sa bcu la ni gnas nas kyang*// thams cad de bzhin gshegs gyur cig /ji srid sdug bsngal rgya mtsho las// de kun thar bgyid nus srid du// sems can re re'i phyir yang ni// bskal pa bye bar spyad par bgyi// gser 'od dam pa zhes bgyi ba// las rnams thams cad 'byang bgyid pa// zab mo dag ni ston pa 'di// sems can dag la bstan par bgyi// gang gis bskal pa stong rnams su// sdig pa shin tu mi bzad bgyis// lan gcig rab tu bshags pa yis// de dag thams cad byang bar 'gyur// gang gis las kyi sgrib pa rnams// myur du yang dag zad 'gyur ba// gser 'od dam pa dge ba yi// bshags pa 'di dag bshags nas ni// rin chen 'byung gnas mchog bcu po// sa bcu la ni gnas par bgyi// sangs rgyas yon tan snang bar bgyi// srid pa'i mtsho las bsgral bar bgyi// sangs rgyas rgya mtsho chu bo dang*// yon tan rgya mtsho zab mo 'di// sangs rgyas yon tan bsam yas kyis/

thams cad mkhyen du rdzogs par bgyi// ting 'dzin brgya phrag stong rnams dang*// gzungs rnams bsam gyis mi khyab dang*// dbang stobs byang chub yan lag gis// stobs bcu dam par 'gyur bar bgyi// dgongs pa'i thugs kyis sangs rgyas rnams// bdag la rnam par gzigs su gsol// thugs rje ldan pa'i thugs kyis ni/ nongs par rab tu gzung du gsol// bdag gis bskal pa brgya rnams su// sngon chad sdig pa gang bgyis pa// de phyir bdag ni mya ngan sems// phongs dang mya ngan 'jigs pas gzir// sdig pa'i las la 'jigs par bgyi// yid ni rtag tu dman par gyur// gang dang gang du spyod bgyid pa// bdag ni gang du dga' ma mchis// sangs rgyas thams cad thugs rje ldan// 'gro ba kun gyi 'jigs sel bas// nongs par rab tu gzung du gsol// 'jigs pa dag las bdag thar mdzod// bdag gi nyon mongs las rnams kyi// dri ma de bzhin gshegs pas gsol// sangs rgyas rnams kyis bdag la ni// snying rje'i chu yis bkru bar gsol// sdig pa thams cad bshags par bgyi// sngon chad bdag gis gang bgyis dang*// da ltar bdag gi sdig pa gang*// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// nongs par bgyis pa'i las rnams kun// slan chad mi bgyid bsdam par bgyi// bdag gis nongs par bgyis pa gang*// sdig de bcab par mi bgyi'o// lus kyi las ni rnam gsum dag /ngag gi rnam pa bzhi dag dang*// yid kyi rnam pa gsum po rnams// de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// lus kyis bgyis dang ngag gi las// yid kyis rnam par bsams pa dang*// las rnams bcu po bgyis pa dag /de dag thams cad bdag 'chags so// mi dge'i las bcu spangs nas su// dge ba bcu po bsten bgyi ste// sa bcu la ni bdag gnas kyi// stobs bcu mchog tu 'gyur par bgyi// bdag gis sdig pa'i las gang dag /mi 'dod 'bras bu thob bgyid pa// sangs rgyas spyan sngar mchis nas ni// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyi// 'dzam bu'i gling 'dir gang dag gang*// 'jig rten khams ni gzhan dag tu// gang rnams dge ba'i las bgyid pa// de dag kun la yi rang ngo*// lus dang ngag dang yid kyis kyang*// bdag gis bsod nams gang bsgrubs pa// bdag ni dge ba'i rtsa ba des// byang chub mchog la reg par bgyi// srid 'gro nyam ngar byis pa'i blo yis ni// shin tu mi bzad sdig pa gang bgyis pa// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i spyan sngar mchis nas ni// sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi// skye ba nyam nga srid pa nyam nga dang*// 'jig rten nyam nga g.yo sems nyam nga bar// lus kyi spyod pa nyam nga sna tshogs kyis// bdag gis sdig pa gang bsags de 'chags so// byis pa blun byas nyon mongs nyam nga dang*// sdig pa'i grogs dang phrad pa nyam nga dang*// srid pa nyam nga 'dod chags nyam nga bar// zhe sdang gti mug mun pa nyam nga ba// ngal ba'i nyam nga dus kyi nyam nga dang*// bsod nams sgrub pa nyam nga dag gis kyang*// rgyal ba yang dag mngon sum mchis nas ni// sdig pa de kun so sor bshags par bgyi// zhes gser 'od dam pa las 'byung ba'i bshags pa 'don pa la nan tan bya'o// bdag ni mi shes gti mug pas// rang bzhin kha na ma tho dang*// bcas pa'i sdig pa gang yin las// gang yang rung ba bgyis pa rnams// mgon po'i spyan sngar mngon sum du// thal sbyar sdug bsngal 'jigs sems kyis// yang dang yang du phyag 'tshal zhing*// de dag thams cad bshags par bgyid// 'dren pa rnams kyis bdag gi sdig

/nongs pa lags par gzung du gsol// 'di ni bzang po ma lags pas// slad chad bdag ni yong mi bgyid// 'dir so byang sngags gsum gyi bshags tshig 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyis mdzad pa 'don/ ༈ /bcu bzhi pa skyabs 'gro ni/ byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// phyogs rnams kun na bzhugs pa yi// rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems// thugs rje chen po mnga' rnams la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// thog ma med ldan 'khor ba nas// tshe rabs 'di'am gzhan dag tu// bdag gis ma 'tshal sdig bgyis pa'am// bgyid du stsal ba nyid dang ni// gti mug 'khrul pas bdag non te// rjes su yi rangs gang bgyis pa// nongs pa de ni mthong bgyis nas// bsam pa thag pas mgon la bshags// bdag gis dkon mchog gsum dang ni// pha ma'am bla ma gzhan dag la// nyon mongs sgo nas lus ngag dang*// yid kyis gnong bgyis gang lags dang*// nyes pa du mas skyon chags pa'i// sdig can bdag gis sdig pa gang*// shin tu mi bzad bgyis pa de// thams cad 'dren pa rnams la bshags// bdag ni sdig pa ma byang ba'i// sngon du 'gum par 'gyur du mchi// ji ltar 'di las nges thar bar// myur pa'i tshul gyis bskyab tu gsol// de bas rgyal ba 'gro ba'i mgon// 'gro ba skyob pa'i don brtson pa// stobs chen 'jigs pa kun sel la// de ring nyid nas skyabs su mchi// de yi thugs su chud pa'i chos// 'khor ba'i 'jigs pa sel ba dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs la yang*// de bzhin yang dag skyabs su mchi// bdag ni 'jigs pa rnam skrag pas// kun tu bzang la bdag nyid 'bul// 'jam pa'i dbyangs la bdag nyid kyis// bdag gi lus ni dbul bar bgyi// thugs rje'i spyod pa ma 'khrul ba// spyan ras gzigs mgon de la yang*// nyam thag nga ros 'o dod 'bod// sdig ldan bdag la bskyab tu gsol// 'phags pa nam mkha'i snying po dang*// sa yi snying po dag dang ni// thugs rje che mgon thams cad la// skyabs tshol snying nas 'o dod 'bod// gang zhig mthong na gshin rje yi// pho nya la sogs sdang ba rnams// skrag nas phyogs bcur 'byed byed pa// rdo rje can la skyabs su mchi// sngon chad khyed kyi bka' las 'das// da ni 'jigs pa che mthong nas// khyed la skyabs su mchi lags kyi// 'jigs pa myur du bsal du gsol/

༈ /bco lnga pa sems bskyed ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// bdag kyang 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyid cing*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// de ltar shlo ka gnyis po de lan gsum brjod pas sems bskyed blang*/ deng du bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su bdag deng gyur// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// bdag gis de ring skyob pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyi// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// bdag gi dge ba'i las ni 'di dag gis// 'jig rten 'dir ni myur du 'tshang rgya shog /'gro la phan phyir chos kyang ston bgyid cing*// sems can sdug bsngal mang pos gzir las sgrol// bcu drug pa yid rang ni/ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba kun dang sangs rgyas sras// rang rgyal rnams dang slob dang mi slob dang*// 'gro ba kun gyi bsod nams gang la yang*// de dag kun gyi rjes su bdag yi rangs// sems can kun gyi ngan song gi// sdug bsngal ngal bso'i dge ba dang*// sdug bsngal can dag bder gnas la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// byang chub rgyur gyur dge bsags pa// de la rjes su yi rang ngo*// lus can 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal las// nges par thar la yi rang ngo*// skyob pa rnams kyi byang chub dang*// rgyal sras sa la'ang yi rang ngo*// sems can thams cad phan mdzad pa'i// thugs bskyed dge ba rgya mtsho dang*// sems can phan par mdzad pa la// dga' bas rjes su yi rang ngo*// bcu bdun pa chos 'khor bskor bar bskul ba ni/

gang rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten sgron ma dag /byang chub rim par sangs rgyas ma chags brnyes// mgon po de dag bdag gis thams cad la// 'khor lo bla na med par bskor bar bskul// phyogs rnams kun gyi sangs rgyas la// thal mo sbyar te gsol ba ni// sems can sdug bsngal mun 'thoms la// chos kyi sgron me sbar du gsol// bco brgyad pa mya ngan las mi 'da' bar gsol ba gdab pa ni/ mya ngan 'da' ston gang bzhed de dag la// 'gro ba kun la phan zhing bde ba'i phyir// bskal pa zhing gi rdul snyed bzhugs par yang*// bdag gis thal mo rab sbyar gsol bar bgyi// rgyal ba mya ngan 'da' bzhed la// thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba ni// 'gro 'di sdongs par mi 'god cing*// bskal pa grangs med bzhugs par gsol// bcu dgu pa bsngo ba ni/ phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rangs bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad bdag gis byang chub phyir bsngo'o// de ltar 'di dag kun byas te// dge ba bdag gis bsags pa gang*// des ni sems can thams cad kyi// sdug bsngal thams cad sel bar shog /'gro ba nad pa ji srid du// nad sos gyur gyi bar du ni// sman dang sman pa nyid dag dang*// de yi nad g.yog byed par shog /zas dang skom gyi char phab ste// bkres dang skom pa'i sdug bsngal bsal// mu ge'i bskal pa bar ma'i tshe// bdag ni zas dang skom du gyur// sems can phongs shing dbul ba la// bdag ni mi zad gter gyur te// yo byad mkho dgu sna tshogs su// mdun na nye bar gnas gyur cig /lus dang de bzhin longs spyod dang*// dus gsum dge ba thams cad kyang*// sems can kun gyi don sgrub phyir// phangs pa med par gtang bar bya// thams cad gtang bas mya ngan 'da'// bdag blo mya ngan 'das pa sgrub// thams cad gtong bar chabs cig la// sems can rnams la gtong ba mchog

/bdag gis lus can thams cad la// lus 'di ci bder byin zin gyis// rtag tu gsod dang smod pa dang*// brdeg sogs ci dgar byed la rab// bdag gi lus la rtse byed dam// co 'dri ga zha'i rgyu byed kyang*// bdag gi lus 'di byin zin gyis// 'di yi kha tas ci zhig bya// de la gnod par mi 'gyur ba'i// las gang yin pa byed du chug /bdag la dmigs nas nam du yang*// 'ga' yang don med ma gyur cig /bdag la dmigs nas gang dag gi /khro 'am dad pa'i sems byung ba// de nyid rtag tu de dag gi// don kun grub pa'i rgyur gyur cig /gang dag bdag la kha zer ram// gzhan dag gnod pa byed pa'am// de bzhin phyar ka gtong yang rung*// thams cad byang chub skal ldan gyur// bdag ni mgon med rnams kyi mgon// lam zhugs rnams kyi ded dpon dang*// brgal 'dod rnams kyi gru dang ni// gzings dang zam pa nyid du gyur// gling don gnyer la gling dang ni// gnas mal 'dod la gnas mal dang*// bdag ni lus can bran 'dod pa// kun gyi bran du 'gyur bar shog /yid bzhin nor dang bum pa bzang*// rig sngags grub dang sman chen dang*// dpag bsam gyi ni shing dag dang*// lus can rnams kyi 'dod 'jor gyur// sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang*// nam mkha' bzhin du rtag par yang*// sems can dpag tu med pa yi// rnam mang nyer 'tsho'i gzhir yang shog /de bzhin nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa'i// sems can khams la rnam kun tu// thams cad mya ngan 'das bar du// bdag ni nyer 'tsho'i rgyur yang shog/ ༈ /gsung ngag rin po che'i lam rim rgyud la skye ba'i smon lam bzhugs so// na mo gu ru we/ phun tshogs dge legs kun 'byung drin can rje// phul byung mtshan dpe'i dpal 'bar rdo rje 'chang*// phas rgol tshar gcod mthu stobs dbang phyug zhabs// phan bde'i lam ston rje btsun sa skya pa// brgyud par bcas pa'i mkhyen brtse'i spyan ras kyis// bu gcig pa la brtse ba'i ma bzhin du// rnal 'byor bdag la rgyun du legs gzigs nas// yid la smon pa'i gnas 'di 'grub par mdzod// snang gsum gyi ma dag pa'i nyes dmigs ni/

srid gsum 'khor ba mtha' med 'gro ba rnams// sdug bsngal 'du byed 'gyur ba'i sdug bsngal gyis// rgyun du gtses shing bde ba'i skabs med par// nges 'byung drag po gting nas skye bar shog /dal 'byor rnyed dka' ni/ legs brgyas bsgrubs pa'i lus rten phun tshogs 'di// rnyed par dka' zhing 'jig par sla ba yi// rang bzhin rtogs nas skad cig g.yel med par// dal 'byor lus la snying po len par shog /las rgyu 'bras ni/ kun rdzob 'khrul pa'i bde sdug snang ba rnams// sngon bsags las kyi rjes su 'brang ba yi// las 'bras bslu ba med pa'i tshul rtogs nas// dge sdig blang dor tshul bzhin byed par shog /nyams kyi snang ba smon pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ sdug bsngal rgya mtshor drin can pha ma rnams// las kyi chu bo chen pos khyer mthong nas// bcos min byams dang snying rjes drangs pa yi// byang chub smon pa'i sems mchog bskyed par shog /'jug pa byang chub kyi sems ni/ theg chen lam gyi rtsa ba tshul khrims gsum// bdag gzhan mnyam dang brje ba'i byang chub sems// pha rol phyin drug bsdu dngos bzhi la sogs// rgya chen byang chub spyod la 'jug par shog /don dam byang chub kyi sems ni/ rtse gcig g.yo ba med pa'i zhi gnas dang*// gnas lugs 'khrul med rtogs pa'i lhag mthong gnyis// zung 'jug chu bo'i rgyun ltar bsgoms pa yis// dngos 'dzin 'khrul pa'i dri ma sel bar shog /dag pa'i snang ba ni 'bras bu'i skabs su 'byung bas 'dir ma bkod/ mdo sngags mtshams sbyor ni/ pha rol phyin pa'i lam gyi rgyud sbyangs nas// brgyud pa'i skal ldan rgyud don ma lus rig /snying rjer ldan zhing dam tshig mchog srung ba'i// rdo rje slob dpon tshul bzhin mnyes byed shog /smin byed kyi dbang ni/ de sogs mtshan nyid kun ldan bla ma yis// rang lus gzhir gnas dkyil 'khor rnam bzhi la// rmad byung cho gas dbang bzhi bskur ba yis// lam bzang bzhi yi snod du 'gyur bar shog

/dbang gi dam tshig ni/ dbang las thob pa'i dam tshig sdom pa'i tshogs// srog dang bsdos te tshul bzhin bsrungs pa yis// 'gal rkyen nyes tshogs mtha' dag rab bcom nas// sngags kyi lam rnams 'grub pa'i gzhir gyur shog /lta ba ni/ phyi nang dngos kun rang sems snang ba tsam// sems ni ngo bo nyid min sgyu ma bzhin// de yang spros pa'i mtha' dang bral ba yi// dbang gis mtshon pa'i lta ba rtogs par shog /phyi bskyed rim ni/ thog med 'khor ba'i bag chags kyis bslad pa'i// ma dag 'khrul pa'i snod bcud snang ba rnams// thabs la mkhas pas lhag pa'i lhar bsgoms pas// rten dang brten pa'i 'khor lor 'char bar shog /nang bskyed rim ni/ ma bcos lhun gyis grub pa'i lus kyi rtsa// gdan gsum tshang ba'i sku ru bsgoms pa yis// rtsa rlung rgyal bas byin gyis brlabs byas nas// bum dbang gi lta ba ni/ snang stong zung 'jug ye shes skye bar shog /gsang dbang gi lam rlung dang gtum mo// sna tshogs kun rtog skyed byed las kyi rlung*// sbyor ba bdun gyis dbang du byas pa yis// gtum mo'i me drod phyogs med rab sbar nas// lta ba ni/ gsal stong zung 'jug ye shes skye bar shog /gsum pa'i lam ni/ las kyi phyag rgya dngos sam ye shes la// 'du shes gsum ldan sbyor bas snyoms zhugs nas// yas babs dga' ba bzhi yi rim gyis ni// lta ba ni/ bde stong zung 'jug ye shes skye bar shog /bzhi pa'i lam ni/ lus dang ngag gi rba rlabs dbang gyur nas// ting 'dzin sems kyi rba rlabs gsum bsgoms pas// gzung 'dzin gnyis kyi rba rlabs rengs pa yis// lta ba ni/ bde stong mchog gi ye shes skye bar shog /'dus pa gsum mthar phyin nas 'phags pa'i lam gyi mtshams sbyor ni/ de ltar rim gnyis bsam gtan bsgoms pa las// rang lus ngag la nyams gsum skyes pa yis// 'dus pa gsum gyi lam rnams mthar phyin nas// pad can lung bstan sprul sku'i zhal mthong shog

/grub mtha' snyogs te bla ma na 'pho ba na/ grub mtha' re re la/ bla ma gang la/ dbang gang blang dkyil 'khor gang gnas gyur/ yon tan gang thob/ grub mtha' gang snyogs pa ste lnga lnga yod pa las/ grub mtha' dang po'i lnga ni/ sna tshogs sprul skur dbang bzhi blangs pa yis// yan lag bdun gyi rtsa rnams mngon gyur nas// yon tan brgya phrag bdun gyis brgyan pa yi// 'khor 'das dbyer med grub mtha' snyogs par shog /grub mtha' gnyis pa'i lnga ni/ zung 'jug longs skur dbang bzhi blangs pa yis// yi ge bha ga'i dkyil 'khor mngon gyur nas// rigs drug so so'i skad du chos ston pa'i// ma 'dres yongs rdzogs grub mtha' snyogs par shog /grub mtha' gsum pa'i lnga ni/ bde chen chos skur dbang bzhi blangs pa yis// gsang ba bdud rtsi'i dkyil 'khor mngon gyur nas// nyi khri chig stong rgyu ba 'gags pa yis// bde stong chung ngu'i grub mtha' snyogs par shog /grub mtha' bzhi pa'i lnga ni/ dbyer med sku la dbang bzhi blangs pa yis// kun khyab rlung gi dkyil 'khor mngon gyur nas// rnam thar gsum gyi 'bras bus brgyan pa yis// bde stong chen po'i grub mtha' snyogs par shog /nye rgyus 'bras bur mtshams sbyor ba ni/ bcu gnyis sa thob phyag rgya'i bha gar ni// dus gsum bde gshegs bcud 'dus thig le las// 'bras dus dbang gi chu bo blangs pa yis// gtsug tor mchog tu 'gros bzhi thim par shog /'bras bu la gsum las rang don gyi che ba ni/ rten dang brten pa sku lngar gnas gyur cing*// gzhan don gyi che ba ni/ sna tshogs gdul bya'i 'dod dgu'i dpal 'byor skong*// bdag gzhan gnyis ka'i che ba ni/ bdag gzhan mnyam du mngon par 'tshang rgya ba'i// dpag yas yon tan tshogs la dbang 'byor shog /go 'phang mchog de ma thob de srid du// kun mkhyen bla ma'i drung du bdag skye zhing*// nyid thugs brtse ba chen pos rjes bzung ste// lam bzang 'di don sgom pa'i skal ldan shog

/tshe 'di nyid la'ang 'gal rkyen kun spangs shing*// dam pas bsngags pa'i mthun rkyen kun tshang nas// mdo rgyud rgya mtsho'i dgongs pa mthar phyin nas// bde gshegs bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas byed shog /drin chen bla ma rnams kyi byin rlabs dang*// skyabs chen dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang*// dpal chen chos skyong srung ma'i nus mthu yis// rlabs chen smon lam 'di dag myur 'grub shog /ces lam 'bras bu dang bcas pa'i lam gyi rim pa rnams rgyud la skye bar smon lam 'debs pa 'di ni rje btsun bla ma rnams kyi bran du gyur pa dge slong rgyal khams pa seng ge'i mtha' can gyis sbyar ba'o// ༈ /rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i brgyad par gsungs pa'i smon lam dbang bzhi dang sbyar ba/ zhal brgyad bcu drug phyag can rigs su skye// rtsa ba yan lag srung ba'i dam tshig can// tha mal rnam par rtog pas smyo med pa// skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /kye yi rdo rje ngo bo nyid gsum ston// bum dbang bskur ba'i bla ma la gus shing*// sems can kun la snying rje dang ldan pa// skye zhing= /rdo rje dril bu 'dzin dang mi 'bral zhing*// zab mo'i rgyud rgyal chos ni klog pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba bdud rtsi lnga la spyod// skye zhing= /rtsa yig skyon med gsang dbang rigs su skye// thun chag rnam rtog las srung dam tshig can// bsam gtan sgrib pa kun gyis smyo med pa// skye zhing= /kye yi rdo rje rang byung ye shes ston// gsang dbang bskur ba'i bla ma la gus shing*// sems can kun la= /skye zhing= /rdo rje dril bu ro rkyang dbu mar 'dzud// zab mo'i dril chen sgra ni sgrogs pa dang*// btsun mo'i khu ba khams dgu 'dus pa can// skye zhing= /bdud rtsi skyon med gsum pa'i rigs su skye// thig ler gnod pa rnam spang dam tshig can// gsum pa'i nyams dang ma bral skyo med pa// skye zhing=

/kye yi rdo rje lhan skyes ye shes ston// gsum pa bskur ba'i bla ma la gus shing*// sems can kun la= /skye zhing= /rdo rje dril bu mkha' gsang mnyam par sbyor// zab mo bde ba'i nyams dang mi 'bral zhing*// btsun mo phyag rgya bstan dang mi 'bral bar// skye zhing= /snying po skyon med bzhi pa'i rigs su skye// thig le 'dzag pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig can// sgrib pa gsum dang bral bas smyo med pa// skye zhing= /kye yi rdo rje shin tu rnam dag ston// bzhi pa bskur ba'i bla ma la gus shing*// sems can kun la snying rje dang ldan pa// skye zhing= /rdo rje dril bu pad can mkha' gsang sbyor// zab mo'i bde ba'i nyams dang mi 'bral zhing*// btsun mo padma can gyi thig le 'dren// skye zhing skye ba kun tu 'gyur bar shog /rtsa rgyud phyi ma'i brgyad par gsungs pa'i smon lam gyi tshigs bcad gnyis po dbang bzhi la sbyar ba rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug sa skya pa chen po'i gsung bzhin du thar lam bla ma la re ba bsod nams seng ges sbyar ba'o// ༈ /'gro kun dge rtsa ji snyed yod pa dang*// sogs rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba'i snying po dang*/ gzhan yang smon lam mang du btang la/ nyi shu pa bkra shis ni/ 'jig rten 'di'am gzhan dang mtho ris na// sogs bde legs su gyur pa'i tshigs su bcad pa dang*/ gzhan yang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs par bya ba ni/ rgyal mtshan rtse mor dbang gi rgyal po ltar// lhag pa'i lha yi gtsug gi rgyan gyur pa// sgrub pa po la dngos grub mchog stsol ba'i// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /tshogs gnyis mthar phyin dus gsum rgyal ba yi// phrin las sgrub cing yon tan rnam dbyer med// skal pa mnyam pa'i gdul bya smin mdzad pa'i// mnyam med bla ma mchog gi bkra shis shog /phun sum tshogs pa mnga' ba gser gyi ri bo 'dra// sogs dang*/

che ba'i che mchog ston mchog bla na med// sogs/ mi 'gyur lhun po sku yi bkra shis shog /yan lag drug cu gsung gi bkra shis shog /mtha' bral don rtogs thugs kyi bkra shis shog /rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi bkra shis shog /sbyin pa gtong zhing tshul khrims bsrung ba dang*// bzod pa bsgom zhing brtson 'grus brtsam pa dang*// mnyam par 'jog cing gnas lugs rtogs pa yi// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs shog /ston pa 'jig rten khams su byon pa dang*// bstan pa nyi 'od bzhin du gsal ba dang*// bstan 'dzin phu nu bzhin du mthun pa yis// bstan pa yun ring gnas pa'i bkra shis shog /bar 'dir spro na thun mong ma yin pa'i bla brgyud sogs dang*/ gong gi phyag 'tshal la 'don pa bsgyur te yi dam gyi bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod do// de dag ni yan lag nyi shu pa sems bskyed blang ba dang bcas pa yin la/ cung zad mdor bsdus pa la dga' ba'i tshe/ mchod phreng rab 'byams rgya mtsho'am/ mchod yon phal cher ma gang rigs re bya/ phyag 'tshal gong ma'i dod du bstod pa'i phyag 'tshal bcug nas/ mchod pa'i skabs bstod pa mi dgos so// shin tu bsdu na yan lag bdun pa bzang spyod nas 'byung ba kho nas kyang chog la/ bzhugs gsol yan chad dang sems bskyed dngos gzhi gong ltar blang ngo*// gang ltar yang de rnams sngon du song nas/ yang dag pa'i don la mnyam par 'jog pa'am/ bla ma'i gsol 'debs sam/ mdo 'don pa'am/ gtor ma gtong ba'am/ gzungs sngags bzla ba'am/ bstod sgrub sogs ci nus su nyams su blangs te/ mthar/ ༈ /rgya gar skad du/ ārya ṣa ṭa mu ki nā ma dhā ra ṇī/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs/ 'phags pa 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das 'khor gyi khyams gnas gtsang ma'i steng*/ nam mkha'i dkyil na gnas pa rin po che sna bdun gyis rab tu rnam par phye bas spras pa na/

byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs grangs med pa dang thabs gcig tu bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das kyis byang chub sems dpa' rnams la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu dag khyed kyis 'gro ba thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di zungs shig de ni 'di lta ste/ bdag 'khor ba na 'khor ba'i tshe/ sdug bsngal gang ci myong pa de sems can thams cad dang mnyam pa nyid du mi shes pa'i mtshan nyid du ma gyur cig bdag gis 'jig rten pa'i phun sum tshogs pa'i bde ba gang ci myong ba de sems can thams cad dang thun mong du yongs su spyod par gyur cig bdag la sdig pa mi dge ba'i las kyi sgrib pa gang ci yod pa de so sor bshags pa bla na med pas so sor ma bshags par ma gyur cig bdag la bdud kyi las gang dag yod pa de dag yongs su shes pa bla na med pas yongs su mi shes par ma gyur cig bdag gi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ldan pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba 'jig rten pa'am/ 'jig rten las 'das pa yang rung gang ci yod pa de'i 'bras bu bla na med pa'i ye shes su gyur cig bdag gi rnam par grol ba gang yin pa des sems can thams cad rnam par thar par gyur cig 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa la bdag gnas par ma gyur cig tadya thā/ oṃ kṣa me kṣa me/ kṣānte kṣānte/ dme dme/ dānte dānte/ bha dre bha dre/ su bha dre su bha dre/ tsand+re tsand+re/ su tsand+re su tsand+re/ tsand+ra ki ra ṇe/ tsand+ra wa ti/ te dzo wa ti/ dharma wa ti/ ya sho wa ti/ brahma wa ti/ sarba kle sha bi sho dha ni/ sarba artha sā dha ni/ sarba a nartha pra sha ma ṇi/ pa ra ma artha sā dha ni/ kā ya bi sho dha ni/ wā gi sho dha ni/ ma naḥsaṃ sho dha ni swā hā/ rigs kyi bu de ltar na rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs 'di nyin lan gsum mtshan lan gsum brjod na/ de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad byang bar gyur nas skye ba bdun gyi bar du des ni skye bar dran par 'gyur ro// bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das dgyes shing de skad ces bka' stsal pa la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de dag dang gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu de dag yi rangs te/

bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa sgo drug pa zhes bya ba'i gzungs rdzogs so// de nas 'phags pa bzang po spyod pa dang*/ byams pa'i smon lam dang*/ rdo rje rgyal mtshan gyi bsngo ba sogs thams cad dam gang rung zhig gis dge ba byang chub tu bsngo/ shis brjod kyi tshigs su bcad pa'ang brjod do// de ltar de dag ni rgyas par bya ba'i tshul te/ 'bring po tsam du byed na/ thog mar byin rlabs kyang*/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa dang sogs nas/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis deng 'dir khor yug gi sa gzhi 'di dag bde ba can gyi zhing gi bkod pa lta bu phun sum tshogs pa'i rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa mdzes shing yid du 'ong ba bsam gyis mi khyab par gyur/ thams cad du yang sa gzhi dag /gseg ma la sogs med pa dang*// lag mthil ltar mnyam baiḍūrya'i// rang bzhin 'jam por gnas gyur cig /phun sum tshogs pa'i zhing de dag tu lha dang mi'i yo byad dam pa gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ dri dang*/ ro dang*/ reg bya la sogs pa rnam par dag cing yid du 'ong ba mchod pa'i sprin rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab pas nam mkha'i khams thams cad gang bar gyur/ ces dang mchod pa'i sprin gyi gzungs brjod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dngos gzhi tshogs zhing spyan 'dren nas brtsams/ mjug bsngo smon shis brjod kyi bar bsags sbyong gi sgo yan lag bdun pa rnams kyang 'bring po'i tshul du nyams su blang bar bya ba yin la/ gang ltar yang 'di dag ni tshogs pas kyang bsgrub tu rung ba'i chos spyod kyi rim pa dang*/ las dang po pa'i gang zag 'ga' zhig nyin zhag phrugs gcig tu ji ltar bya ba gtso bor smos nas/ rang gis ji ltar blangs pa'i bslab pa la nan tan snying por byed pa nyid gzhir byas te/ nyin zhag phrugs gcig las nam gyi cha smad la bab pa na gnyid dang rmugs pa dang le lo spangs te/

lus gnad bcas yid ma yengs par sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ gtong ba dang tshul khrims dang lha rjes su dran pa'i sgo nas dad pa bskyed pa dang*/ tshe 'di dang 'khor ba la yid nges par 'byung ba dang*/ thar pa'i lam gyi ngo bo dang phan yon yid la byed pa dang*/ sems can thams cad la byams pa dang snying rje dang byang chub kyi sems drag tu sgom zhing*/ man ngag thob na bsam gtan cung zad bya'o// de nas skya rengs dang po shar ba na/ phyag 'tshal ba sogs yan lag bdun pa rgyas pa rnams bya zhing*/ nyin mo'i dang po la/ phyag 'tshal ba'am/ mchod pa 'bul ba'am/ gtor ma gtong ba'am/ mdo sde klog pa'am/ mchod rten la skor ba la sogs pa thun mtshams gyi spyod pa ci 'grub cig byas nas/ kha zas kyi bya ba la 'jug ste/ phud dang lhag ma la sogs pa'i mchod pa ma chad par bya'o// de'i rjes su gtsang sbra dang ldan pas yan lag bdun pa sngon du 'gro bzhin du/ klog pa'am/ chos nyan pa'am/ bsam gtan la sogs pa gang rung zhig bya'o// nyi ma phyi phred kyi dus na dub pa bsang ba'i don du chos dang ldan pa'i gtam gyis rab tu dga' bar byas nas/ sātstsha gdab pa la sogs pa thun mtshams kyi spyod pa ci rigs pa la 'jug go /dgong mo'i thun la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro ba'i sgo nas/ 'phags pa rnams la mchod pa dang 'byung po rnams la gtor ma rgya cher byin la/ smon lam gyi khyad par mang du gdab par bya'o// nam gyi cha stod la bsam gtan nam/ gsung rab 'don pa'am/ de dag gi don sems pa la nan tan du bya zhing*/ gung thun la dge ba'i sems kyis nyal bar bya'o// tshes brgyad dang*/ bcu bzhi dang*/ bco lnga dang*/ gnam stong rnams la chos ston pa po yod na mtshan mo hril gyis chos ston pa nyan pa'am/ nam phyed la thug gi bar du chos nyan bshad bya'o// de lta bu ma 'byor na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gzugs la mchod pa bya ba'am/ gang yang rung ba'i chos spyod kyi rim pas dus 'da' bar bya'o// ci ste sngags kyi theg pa la zhugs pa zhig yin na/
